![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1808]]

1808. "Tadāsi yaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ, tadāsi lomahaṃsanaṃ;
Yaṃ pañjalikato rājā, samhā raṭṭhā nirajjatī"ti. ^14-16478

Tattha **sivikaññā**ti bhikkhave, phussatiyā paridevitasaddaṃ sutvā sabbāpi sañjayassa sivirañño itthiyo samāgatā hutvā pakkanduṃ parideviṃsu. **Vessantaranivesane**ti tattha itthīnaṃ pakkanditasaddaṃ sutvā vessantarassapi nivesane tatheva pakkanditvā dvīsu rājakulesu keci sakabhāvena saṇṭhātuṃ asakkontā vātavegena sampamathitā sālā viya patitvā parivattantā parideviṃsu. **Tato ratyā vivasāne**ti bhikkhave, tato tassā rattiyā accayena sūriye uggate dānaveyyāvatikā "dānaṃ paṭiyādita"nti rañño ārocayiṃsu. Atha vessantaro rājā pātova nhatvā sabbālaṅkārappaṭimaṇḍito sādurasabhojanaṃ bhuñjitvā mahājanaparivuto sattasatakaṃ mahādānaṃ dātuṃ dānaggaṃ upāgami. ^14-16479

**Dethā**ti tattha gantvā saṭṭhisahassaamacce āṇāpento evamāha. **Vāruṇi**nti "majjadānaṃ nāma nipphala"nti jānāti, evaṃ santepi "surāsoṇḍā dānaggaṃ patvā ‘vessantarassa dānagge suraṃ na labhimhā’ti vattuṃ mā labhantū"ti dāpesi. **Vanibbake**ti vanibbakajanesu kañci ekampi mā viheṭhayittha. **Paṭipūjitā**ti mayā pūjitā hutvā yathā maṃ thomayamānā gacchanti, tathā tumhe karothāti vadati. ^14-16480

Iti so suvaṇṇālaṅkārānaṃ suvaṇṇadhajānaṃ hemajālappaṭicchannānaṃ hatthīnaṃ sattasatāni ca, tathārūpānaññeva assānaṃ sattasatāni ca, sīhacammādīhi parikkhittānaṃ nānāratanavicitrānaṃ suvaṇṇadhajānaṃ rathānaṃ sattasatāni, sabbālaṅkārappaṭimaṇḍitānaṃ uttamarūpadharānaṃ khattiyakaññādīnaṃ itthīnaṃ sattasatāni, suvinītānaṃ susikkhitānaṃ dāsānaṃ sattasatāni, tathā dāsīnaṃ sattasatāni, varausabhajeṭṭhakānaṃ kuṇḍopadohinīnaṃ dhenūnaṃ sattasatāni, aparimāṇāni pānabhojanānīti sattasatakaṃ mahādānaṃ adāsi. Tasmiṃ evaṃ dānaṃ dadamāne jetuttaranagaravāsino khattiyabrāhmaṇavessasuddādayo "sāmi, vessantara siviraṭṭhavāsino taṃ ‘dānaṃ detī’ti pabbājenti, tvaṃ puna dānameva desī"ti parideviṃsu. Tena vuttaṃ – ^14-16481

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1809]]

1809. "Athettha vattatī saddo, tumulo bheravo mahā;
Dānena taṃ nīharanti, puna dānaṃ adā tuva"nti. ^14-16482

Dānapaṭiggāhakā pana dānaṃ gahetvā "idāni kira vessantaro rājā amhe anāthe katvā araññaṃ pavisissati, ito paṭṭhāya kassa santikaṃ gamissāmā"ti chinnapādā viya patantā āvattantā parivattantā mahāsaddena parideviṃsu. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16483

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1810]]

1810. "Te su mattā kilantāva, sampatanti vanibbakā;
Nikkhamante mahārāje, sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhane"ti. ^14-16484

Tattha **te su mattā**ti **su**-kāro nipātamatto, te vanibbakāti attho. **Mattā kilantāvā**ti mattā viya kilantā viya ca hutvā. **Sampatantī**ti parivattitvā bhūmiyaṃ patanti. **Acchecchuṃ vatā**ti chindiṃsu, **vatā**ti nipātamattaṃ. **Yathā**ti yena kāraṇena. **Atiyakkhā**ti bhūtavijjā ikkhaṇikāpi. **Vassavarā**ti uddhaṭabījā orodhapālakā. **Vacanatthenā**ti vacanakāraṇena. **Samhā raṭṭhā nirajjatī**ti attano raṭṭhā niggacchati. **Gāmaṇīyehī**ti hatthācariyehi. **Ājānīyevā**ti jātisampanne. **Gāmaṇīyehī**ti assācariyehi. **Illiyācāpadhāribhī**ti illiyañca cāpañca dhārentehi. **Dīpe athopi veyyagghe**ti dīpicammabyagghacammaparikkhitte. **Ekamekā rathe ṭhitā**ti so kira ekamekaṃ itthiratanaṃ rathe ṭhapetvā aṭṭhaaṭṭhavaṇṇadāsīhi parivutaṃ katvā adāsi. ^14-16485

**Nikkharajjūhī**ti suvaṇṇasuttamayehi pāmaṅgehi. **Āḷārapamhā**ti visālakkhigaṇḍā. **Hasulā**ti mhitapubbaṅgamakathā. **Susaññā**ti sussoṇiyo. **Tanumajjhimā**ti karatalamiva tanumajjhimabhāgā. Tadā pana devatāyo jambudīpatale rājūnaṃ "vessantaro rājā mahādānaṃ detī"ti ārocayiṃsu, tasmā te khattiyā devatānubhāvenāgantvā tā gaṇhitvā pakkamiṃsu. **Kaṃsupadhāraṇā**ti idha **kaṃsa**nti rajatassa nāmaṃ, rajatamayena khīrapaṭicchanabhājanena saddhiññeva adāsīti attho. **Padinnamhī**ti dīyamāne. **Sampakampathā**ti dānatejena kampittha. **Yaṃ pañjalikato**ti yaṃ so vessantaro rājā mahādānaṃ datvā añjaliṃ paggayha attano dānaṃ namassamāno "sabbaññutaññāṇassa me idaṃ paccayo hotū"ti pañjalikato ahosi, tadāpi bhīsanakameva ahosi, tasmiṃ khaṇe pathavī kampitthāti attho. **Nirajjatī**ti evaṃ katvā niggacchatiyeva, na koci naṃ nivāretīti attho. ^14-16486

Apica kho tassa dānaṃ dadantasseva sāyaṃ ahosi. So attano nivesanameva gantvā "mātāpitaro vanditvā sve gamissāmī"ti cintetvā alaṅkatarathena mātāpitūnaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ gato. Maddīdevīpi "ahaṃ sāminā saddhiṃ gantvā mātāpitaro anujānāpessāmī"ti teneva saddhiṃ gatā. Mahāsatto pitaraṃ vanditvā attano gamanabhāvaṃ kathesi. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16487

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1811]]

1811. "Āmantayittha rājānaṃ, sañjayaṃ dhamminaṃ varaṃ;
Avaruddhasi maṃ deva, vaṅkaṃ gacchāmi pabbataṃ. ^14-16488

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1812]]

1812. "Ye hi keci mahārāja, bhūtā ye ca bhavissare;
Atittāyeva kāmehi, gacchanti yamasādhanaṃ. ^14-16489

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1813]]

1813. "Svāhaṃ sake abhissasiṃ, yajamāno sake pure;
Sivīnaṃ vacanatthena, samhā raṭṭhā nirajjahaṃ. ^14-16490

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1814]]

1814. "Aghaṃ taṃ paṭisevissaṃ, vane vāḷamigākiṇṇe;
Khaggadīpinisevite, ahaṃ puññāni karomi;
Tumhe paṅkamhi sīdathā"ti. ^14-16491

Tattha **dhamminaṃ vara**nti dhammikarājūnaṃ antare uttamaṃ. **Avaruddhasī**ti raṭṭhā nīharasi. **Bhūtā**ti atītā. **Bhavissare**ti ye ca anāgate bhavissanti, paccuppanne ca nibbattā. **Yamasādhana**nti yamarañño āṇāpavattiṭṭhānaṃ. **Svāhaṃ sake abhissasi**nti so ahaṃ attano nagaravāsinoyeva pīḷesiṃ. Kiṃ karonto? **Yajamāno sake pure**ti. Pāḷiyaṃ pana "so aha"nti likhitaṃ. **Nirajjaha**nti nikkhanto ahaṃ. **Aghaṃ ta**nti yaṃ araññe vasantena paṭisevitabbaṃ dukkhaṃ, taṃ paṭisevissāmi. **Paṅkamhī**ti tumhe pana kāmapaṅkamhi sīdathāti vadati. ^14-16492

Iti mahāsatto imāhi catūhi gāthāhi pitarā saddhiṃ kathetvā mātu santikaṃ gantvā vanditvā pabbajjaṃ anujānāpento evamāha – ^14-16493

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1815]]

1815. "Anujānāhi maṃ amma, pabbajjā mama ruccati;
Svāhaṃ sake abhissasiṃ, yajamāno sake pure;
Sivīnaṃ vacanatthena, samhā raṭṭhā nirajjahaṃ. ^14-16494

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1816]]

1816. "Aghaṃ taṃ paṭisevissaṃ, vane vāḷamigākiṇṇe;
Khaggadīpinisevite, ahaṃ puññāni karomi;
Tumhe paṅkamhi sīdathā"ti. ^14-16495

Taṃ sutvā phussatī āha – ^14-16496

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1817]]

1817. "Anujānāmi taṃ putta, pabbajjā te samijjhatu;
Ayañca maddī kalyāṇī, susaññā tanumajjhimā; ^14-16497

Acchataṃ saha puttehi, kiṃ araññe karissatī"ti. ^14-16498

Tattha **samijjhatū**ti jhānena samiddhā hotu. **Acchata**nti acchatu, idheva hotūti vadati. ^14-16499

Vessantaro āha – ^14-16500

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1818]]

1818. "Nāhaṃ akāmā dāsimpi, araññaṃ netumussahe;
Sace icchati anvetu, sace nicchati acchatū"ti. ^14-16501

Tattha **akāmā**ti amma, kiṃ nāmetaṃ kathetha, ahaṃ anicchāya dāsimpi netuṃ na ussahāmīti. ^14-16502

Tato puttassa kathaṃ sutvā rājā suṇhaṃ yācituṃ paṭipajji. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16503

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1819]]

1819. "Tato suṇhaṃ mahārājā, yācituṃ paṭipajjatha;
Mā candanasamācāre, rajojallaṃ adhārayi. ^14-16504

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1820]]

1820. "Mā kāsiyāni dhāretvā, kusacīraṃ adhārayi;
Dukkho vāso araññasmiṃ, mā hi tvaṃ lakkhaṇe gamī"ti. ^14-16505

Tattha **paṭipajjathā**ti bhikkhave, puttassa kathaṃ sutvā rājā suṇhaṃ yācituṃ paṭipajji. **Candanasamācāre**ti lohitacandanena parikiṇṇasarīre. **Mā hi tvaṃ lakkhaṇe gamī**ti subhalakkhaṇena samannāgate mā tvaṃ araññaṃ gamīti. ^14-16506

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1821]]

1821. "Tamabravi rājaputtī, maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā;
Nāhaṃ taṃ sukhamiccheyyaṃ, yaṃ me vessantaraṃ vinā"ti. ^14-16507

Tattha **tamabravī**ti taṃ sasuraṃ abravi. ^14-16508

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1822]]

1822. "Tamabravi mahārājā, sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhano;
Iṅgha maddi nisāmehi, vane ye honti dussahā. ^14-16509

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1823]]

1823. "Bahū kīṭā paṭaṅgā ca, makasā madhumakkhikā;
Tepi taṃ tattha hiṃ seyyuṃ, taṃ te dukkhataraṃ siyā. ^14-16510

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1824]]

1824. "Apare passa santāpe, nadīnupanisevite;
Sappā ajagarā nāma, avisā te mahabbalā. ^14-16511

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1825]]

1825. "Te manussaṃ migaṃ vāpi, api māsannamāgataṃ;
Parikkhipitvā bhogehi, vasamānenti attano. ^14-16512

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1826]]

1826. "Aññepi kaṇhajaṭino, acchā nāma aghammigā;
Na tehi puriso diṭṭho, rukkhamāruyha muccati. ^14-16513

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1827]]

1827. "Saṅghaṭṭayantā siṅgāni, tikkhaggātippahārino;
Mahiṃsā vicarantettha, nadiṃ sotumbaraṃ pati. ^14-16514

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1828]]

1828. "Disvā migānaṃ yūthānaṃ, gavaṃ sañcarataṃ vane;
Dhenuva vacchagiddhāva, kathaṃ maddi karissasi. ^14-16515

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1829]]

1829. "Disvā sampatite ghore, dumaggesu plavaṅgame;
Akhettaññāya te maddi, bhavissate mahabbhayaṃ. ^14-16516

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1830]]

1830. "Yā tvaṃ sivāya sutvāna, muhuṃ uttasayī pure;
Sā tvaṃ vaṅkamanuppattā, kathaṃ maddi karissasi. ^14-16517

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1831]]

1831. "Ṭhite majjhanhike kāle, sannisinnesu pakkhisu;
Saṇateva brahāraññaṃ, tattha kiṃ gantumicchasī"ti. ^14-16518

Tattha **tamabravī**ti taṃ suṇhaṃ abravi. **Apare passa santāpe**ti aññepi santāpe bhayajanake pekkha. **Nadīnupanisevite**ti nadīnaṃ upanisevite āsannaṭṭhāne, nadīkūle vasanteti attho. **Avisā**ti nibbisā. **Api māsanna**nti āsannaṃ attano sarīrasamphassaṃ āgatanti attho. **Aghammigā**ti aghakarā migā, dukkhāvahā migāti attho. **Nadiṃ sotumbaraṃ patī**ti sotumbarāya nāma nadiyā tīre. **Yūthāna**nti yūthāni, ayameva vā pāṭho. **Dhenuva vacchagiddhāvā**ti tava dārake apassantī vacchagiddhā dhenu viya kathaṃ karissasi. **Va**-kāro panettha nipātamattova. **Sampatite**ti sampatante. **Ghore**ti bhīsanake virūpe. **Plavaṅgame**ti makkaṭe. **Akhettaññāyā**ti araññabhūmiakusalatāya. **Bhavissate**ti bhavissati. **Sivāya sutvānā**ti siṅgāliyā saddaṃ sutvā. **Muhu**nti punappunaṃ. **Uttasayī**ti uttasasi. **Saṇatevā**ti nadati viya saṇantaṃ viya bhavissati. ^14-16519

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1832]]

1832. "Tamabravi rājaputtī, maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā;
Yāni etāni akkhāsi, vane paṭibhayāni me;
Sabbāni abhisambhossaṃ, gacchaññeva rathesabha. ^14-16520

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1833]]

1833. "Kāsaṃ kusaṃ poṭakilaṃ, usiraṃ muñcapabbajaṃ;
Urasā panudahissāmi, nassa hessāmi dunnayā. ^14-16521

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1834]]

1834. "Bahūhi vata cariyāhi, kumārī vindate patiṃ;
Udarassuparodhena, gohanuveṭhanena ca. ^14-16522

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1835]]

1835. "Aggissa pāricariyāya, udakummujjanena ca;
Vedhabyaṃ kaṭukaṃ loke, gacchaññeva rathesabha. ^14-16523

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1836]]

1836. "Apissā hoti appatto, ucchiṭṭhamapi bhuñjituṃ;
Yo naṃ hatthe gahetvāna, akāmaṃ parikaḍḍhati;
Vedhabyaṃ kaṭukaṃ loke, gacchaññeva rathesabha. ^14-16524

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1837]]

1837. "Kesaggahaṇamukkhepā, bhūmyā ca parisumbhanā;
Datvā ca no pakkamati, bahuṃ dukkhaṃ anappakaṃ;
Vedhabyaṃ kaṭukaṃ loke, gacchaññeva rathesabha. ^14-16525

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1838]]

1838. "Sukkacchavī vedhaverā, datvā subhagamānino;
Akāmaṃ parikaḍḍhanti, ulūkaññeva vāyasā;
Vedhabyaṃ kaṭukaṃ loke, gacchaññeva rathesabha. ^14-16526

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1839]]

1839. "Api ñātikule phīte, kaṃsapajjotane vasaṃ;
Nevātivākyaṃ na labhe, bhātūhi sakhinīhipi;
Vedhabyaṃ kaṭukaṃ loke, gacchaññeva rathesabha. ^14-16527

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1840]]

1840. "Naggā nadī anudakā, naggaṃ raṭṭhaṃ arājakaṃ;
Itthīpi vidhavā naggā, yassāpi dasa bhātaro;
Vedhabyaṃ kaṭukaṃ loke, gacchaññeva rathesabha. ^14-16528

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1841]]

1841. "Dhajo rathassa paññāṇaṃ, dhūmo paññāṇamaggino;
Rājā raṭṭhassa paññāṇaṃ, bhattā paññāṇamitthiyā;
Vedhabyaṃ kaṭukaṃ loke, gacchaññeva rathesabha. ^14-16529

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1842]]

1842. "Yā daliddī daliddassa, aḍḍhā aḍḍhassa kittimā;
Taṃ ve devā pasaṃsanti, dukkarañhi karoti sā. ^14-16530

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1843]]

1843. "Sāmikaṃ anubandhissaṃ, sadā kāsāyavāsinī;
Pathabyāpi abhijjantyā, vedhabyaṃ kaṭukitthiyā. ^14-16531

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1844]]

1844. "Api sāgarapariyantaṃ, bahuvittadharaṃ mahiṃ;
Nānāratanaparipūraṃ, nicche vessantaraṃ vinā. ^14-16532

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1845]]

1845. "Kathaṃ nu tāsaṃ hadayaṃ, sukharā vata itthiyo;
Yā sāmike dukkhitamhi, sukhamicchanti attano. ^14-16533

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1846]]

1846. "Nikkhamante mahārāje, sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhane;
Tamahaṃ anubandhissaṃ, sabbakāmadado hi me"ti. ^14-16534

Tattha **tamabravī**ti bhikkhave, maddī rañño vacanaṃ sutvā taṃ rājānaṃ abravi. **Abhisambhossa**nti sahissāmi adhivāsessāmi. **Poṭakila**nti poṭakilatiṇaṃ. **Panudahissāmī**ti dvedhā katvā vessantarassa purato gamissāmi. **Udarassuparodhenā**ti upavāsena khudādhivāsena. **Gohanuveṭhanena cā**ti visālakaṭiyo onatapassā ca itthiyo sāmikaṃ labhantīti katvā gohanunā kaṭiphalakaṃ koṭṭāpetvā veṭhanena ca passāni onāmetvā kumārikā patiṃ labhati. **Kaṭuka**nti asātaṃ. **Gacchaññevā**ti gamissāmiyeva. ^14-16535

**Apissā hoti appatto**ti tassā vidhavāya ucchiṭṭhakampi bhuñjituṃ ananucchavikova. **Yo na**nti yo nīcajacco taṃ vidhavaṃ anicchamānaññeva hatthe gahetvā kaḍḍhati. **Kesaggahaṇamukkhepā, bhūmyā ca parisumbhanā**ti asāmikaṃ itthiṃ hatthapādehi kesaggahaṇaṃ, ukkhepā, bhūmiyaṃ pātananti etāni avamaññanāni katvā atikkamanti. **Datvā cā**ti asāmikāya itthiyā evarūpaṃ bahuṃ anappakaṃ dukkhaṃ parapuriso datvā ca **no pakkamati** nirāsaṅko olokentova tiṭṭhati. ^14-16536

**Sukkacchavī**ti nhānīyacuṇṇena uṭṭhāpitacchavivaṇṇā. **Vedhaverā**ti vidhavitthikāmā purisā. **Datvā**ti kiñcideva appamattakaṃ dhanaṃ datvā. **Subhagamānino**ti mayaṃ subhagāti maññamānā. **Akāma**nti taṃ vidhavaṃ asāmikaṃ akāmaṃ. **Ulūkaññeva vāyasā**ti kākā viyaulūkaṃ parikaḍḍhanti. **Kaṃsapajjotane**ti suvaṇṇabhājanābhāya pajjotante. **Vasa**nti evarūpepi ñātikule vasamānā. **Nevātivākyaṃ na labhe**ti "ayaṃ itthī nissāmikā, yāvajīvaṃ amhākaññeva bhāro jāto"tiādīni vacanāni vadantehi bhātūhipi sakhinīhipi ativākyaṃ garahavacanaṃ neva na labhati. **Paññāṇa**nti pākaṭabhāvakāraṇaṃ. ^14-16537

**Yā** **daliddī daliddassā**ti deva, kittisampannā yā itthī attano sāmikassa daliddassa dukkhappattakāle sayampi daliddī samānā dukkhāva hoti, tassa aḍḍhakāle teneva saddhiṃ aḍḍhā sukhappattā hoti, taṃ ve devā pasaṃsanti. Abhijjantyāti abhijjantiyā. Sacepi hi itthiyā sakalapathavī na bhijjati, tāya sakalāya pathaviyā sāva issarā hoti, tathāpi vedhabyaṃ kaṭukamevāti attho. Sukharā vata itthiyoti suṭṭhu kharā vata itthiyo. ^14-16538

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1847]]

1847. "Tamabravi mahārājā, maddiṃ sabbaṅgasobhanaṃ;
Ime te daharā puttā, jālī kaṇhājinā cubho;
Nikkhippa lakkhaṇe gaccha, mayaṃ te posayāmase"ti. ^14-16539

Tattha **jālī kaṇhājinā cubho**ti jālī ca kaṇhājinā cāti ubho. **Nikkhippā**ti ime nikkhipitvā gacchāhīti. ^14-16540

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1848]]

1848. "Tamabravi rājaputtī, maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā;
Piyā me puttakā deva, jālī kaṇhājinā cubho;
Tyamhaṃ tattha ramessanti, araññe jīvasokina"nti. ^14-16541

Tattha **tyamha**nti te dārakā amhākaṃ tattha araññe. **Jīvasokina**nti avigatasokānaṃ hadayaṃ ramayissantīti attho. ^14-16542

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1849]]

1849. "Tamabravi mahārājā, sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhano;
Sālīnaṃ odanaṃ bhutvā, suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ;
Rukkhaphalāni bhuñjantā, kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā. ^14-16543

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1850]]

1850. "Bhutvā satapale kaṃse, sovaṇṇe satarājike;
Rukkhapattesu bhuñjantā, kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā. ^14-16544

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1851]]

1851. "Kāsiyāni ca dhāretvā, khomakoṭumbarāni ca;
Kusacīrāni dhārentā, kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā. ^14-16545

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1852]]

1852. "Vayhāhi pariyāyitvā, sivikāya rathena ca;
Pattikā paridhāvantā, kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā. ^14-16546

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1853]]

1853. "Kūṭāgāre sayitvāna, nivāte phusitaggaḷe;
Sayantā rukkhamūlasmiṃ, kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā. ^14-16547

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1854]]

1854. "Pallaṅkesu sayitvāna, gonake cittasanthate;
Sayantā tiṇasanthāre, kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā. ^14-16548

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1855]]

1855. "Gandhakena vilimpitvā, agarucandanena ca;
Rajojallāni dhārentā, kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā. ^14-16549

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1856]]

1856. "Cāmaramorahatthehi, bījitaṅgā sukhedhitā;
Phuṭṭhā ḍaṃsehi makasehi, kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā"ti. ^14-16550

Tattha **palasate kaṃse**ti palasatena katāya kañcanapātiyā. **Gonake cittasanthate**ti mahāpiṭṭhiyaṃ kāḷakojave ceva vicittake santhare ca. **Cāmaramorahatthehī**ti cāmarehi ceva morahatthehi ca bījitaṅgā. ^14-16551

Evaṃ tesaṃ sallapantānaññeva ratti vibhāyi, sūriyo uggañchi. Mahāsattassa catusindhavayuttaṃ alaṅkatarathaṃ ānetvā rājadvāre ṭhapayiṃsu. Maddīpi sassusasure vanditvā sesitthiyo apaloketvā dve putte ādāya vessantarato paṭhamataraṃ gantvā rathe aṭṭhāsi. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16552

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1857]]

1857. "Tamabravi rājaputtī, maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā;
Mā deva paridevesi, mā ca tvaṃ vimano ahu;
Yathā mayaṃ bhavissāma, tathā hessanti dārakā. ^14-16553

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1858]]

1858. "Idaṃ vatvāna pakkāmi, maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā;
Sivimaggena anvesi, putte ādāya lakkhaṇā"ti. ^14-16554

Tattha **sivimaggenā**ti sivirañño gantabbamaggena. **Anvesī**ti taṃ agamāsi, pāsādā otaritvā rathaṃ abhiruhīti attho. ^14-16555

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1859]]

1859. "Tato vessantaro rājā, dānaṃ datvāna khattiyo;
Pitu mātu ca vanditvā, katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ. ^14-16556

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1860]]

1860. "Catuvāhiṃ rathaṃ yuttaṃ, sīghamāruyha sandanaṃ;
Ādāya puttadārañca, vaṅkaṃ pāyāsi pabbata"nti. ^14-16557

Tattha **tato**ti bhikkhave, tassā maddiyā rathaṃ abhiruhitvā ṭhitakāle. **Datvā**ti hiyyo dānaṃ datvā. **Katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇa**nti padakkhiṇañca katvā. **Na**nti nipātamattaṃ. ^14-16558

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1861]]

1861. "Tato vessantaro rājā, yenāsi bahuko jano;
Āmanta kho taṃ gacchāma, arogā hontu ñātayo"ti. ^14-16559

Tassattho – bhikkhave, tato vessantaro rājā yattha "vessantaraṃ rājānaṃ passissāmā"ti bahuko jano ṭhito āsi, tattha rathaṃ pesetvā mahājanaṃ āpucchanto "āmanta kho taṃ gacchāma, arogā hontu ñātayo"ti āha. Tattha **ta**nti nipātamattaṃ. Bhikkhave, tato vessantaro rājā ñātake āha – "tumhe āmantetvā mayaṃ gacchāma, tumhe sukhitā hotha nidukkhā"ti. ^14-16560

Evaṃ mahāsatto mahājanaṃ āmantetvā "appamattā hotha, dānādīni puññāni karothā"ti tesaṃ ovaditvā pakkāmi. Gacchante pana bodhisatte mātā "putto me dānavittako dānaṃ detū"ti ābharaṇehi saddhiṃ sattaratanapūrāni sakaṭāni ubhosu passesu pesesi. Sopi attano kāyāruḷhameva ābharaṇabhaṇḍaṃ omuñcitvā sampattayācakānaṃ aṭṭhārasa vāre datvā avasesaṃ sabbaṃ adāsi. So nagarā nikkhamitvā ca nivattitvā oloketukāmo ahosi. Athassa manaṃ paṭicca rathappamāṇaṭṭhāne mahāpathavī bhijjitvā kulālacakkaṃ viya parivattitvā rathaṃ nagarābhimukhaṃ akāsi. So mātāpitūnaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ olokesi. Tena kāraṇena pathavīkampo ahosi. Tena vuttaṃ – ^14-16561

"Nikkhamitvāna nagarā, nivattitvā vilokite;
Tadāpi pathavī kampi, sineruvanavaṭaṃsakā"ti. (cariyā. 1.93); ^14-16562

Sayaṃ pana oloketvā maddimpi olokāpetuṃ gāthamāha – ^14-16563

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1862]]

1862. "Iṅgha maddi nisāmehi, rammarūpaṃva dissati;
Āvāsaṃ siviseṭṭhassa, pettikaṃ bhavanaṃ mamā"ti. ^14-16564

Tattha **nisāmehī**ti olokehi. ^14-16565

Atha mahāsatto sahajāte saṭṭhisahassaamacce ca sesajanañca nivattāpetvā rathaṃ pājento maddiṃ āha – "bhadde, sace pacchato yācakā āgacchanti, upadhāreyyāsī"ti. Sāpi olokentī nisīdi. Athassa sattasatakaṃ mahādānaṃ sampāpuṇituṃ asakkontā cattāro brāhmaṇā nagaraṃ āgantvā "kuhiṃ vessantaro rājā"ti pucchitvā "dānaṃ datvā gato"ti vutte "kiñci gahetvā gato"ti pucchitvā "rathena gato"ti sutvā "asse naṃ yācissāmā"ti anubandhiṃsu. Atha maddī te āgacchante disvā "yācakā āgacchanti, devā"ti ārocesi. Mahāsatto rathaṃ ṭhapesi. Te āgantvā asse yāciṃsu. Mahāsatto asse adāsi. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16566

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1863]]

1863. "Taṃ brāhmaṇā anvagamuṃ, te naṃ asse ayācisuṃ;
Yācito paṭipādesi, catunnaṃ caturo haye"ti. ^14-16567

Assesu pana dinnesu rathadhuraṃ ākāseyeva aṭṭhāsi. Atha brāhmaṇesu gatamattesuyeva cattāro devaputtā rohiccamigavaṇṇena āgantvā rathadhuraṃ sampaṭicchitvā agamaṃsu. Mahāsatto tesaṃ devaputtabhāvaṃ ñatvā imaṃ gāthamāha – ^14-16568

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1864]]

1864. "Iṅgha maddi nisāmehi, cittarūpaṃva dissati;
Migarohiccavaṇṇena, dakkhiṇassā vahanti ma"nti. ^14-16569

Tattha **dakkhiṇassā**ti susikkhitā assā viya maṃ vahanti. ^14-16570

Atha naṃ evaṃ gacchantaṃ aparo brāhmaṇo āgantvā rathaṃ yāci. Mahāsatto puttadāraṃ otāretvā tassa rathaṃ adāsi. Rathe pana dinne devaputtā antaradhāyiṃsu. Rathassa dinnabhāvaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16571

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1865]]

1865. "Athettha pañcamo āgā, so taṃ rathamayācatha;
Tassa taṃ yācitodāsi, na cassupahato mano. ^14-16572

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1866]]

1866. "Tato vessantaro rājā, oropetvā sakaṃ janaṃ;
Assāsayi assarathaṃ, brāhmaṇassa dhanesino"ti. ^14-16573

Tattha **athetthā**ti atha tasmiṃ vane. **Na cassupahato mano**ti na cassa mano olīno. **Assāsayī**ti paritosento niyyādesi. ^14-16574

Tato paṭṭhāya pana te sabbepi pattikāva ahesuṃ. Atha mahāsatto maddiṃ avoca – ^14-16575

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1867]]

1867. "Tvaṃ maddi kaṇhaṃ gaṇhāhi, lahu esā kaniṭṭhikā;
Ahaṃ jāliṃ gahessāmi, garuko bhātiko hi so"ti. ^14-16576

Evañca pana vatvā ubhopi khattiyā dve dārake aṅkenādāya pakkamiṃsu. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16577

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1868]]

1868. "Rājā kumāramādāya, rājaputtī ca dārikaṃ;
Sammodamānā pakkāmuṃ, aññamaññaṃ piyaṃvadā"ti. ^14-16578

Dānakaṇḍavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā. ^14-16579

Vanapavesanakaṇḍavaṇṇanā ^14-16580

Te paṭipathaṃ āgacchante manusse disvā "kuhiṃ vaṅkapabbato"ti pucchanti. Manussā "dūre"ti vadanti. Tena vuttaṃ – ^14-16581

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1869]]

1869. "Yadi keci manujā enti, anumagge paṭipathe;
Maggaṃ te paṭipucchāma, ‘kuhiṃ vaṅkatapabbato’. ^14-16582

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1870]]

1870. "Te tattha amhe passitvā, kalunaṃ paridevayuṃ;
Dukkhaṃ te paṭivedenti, dūre vaṅkatapabbato"ti. ^14-16583

Maggassa ubhosu passesu vividhaphaladhārino rukkhe disvā dārakā kandanti. Mahāsattassānubhāvena phaladhārino rukkhā onamitvā hatthasamphassaṃ āgacchanti. Tato supakkaphalāphalāni uccinitvā tesaṃ deti. Taṃ disvā maddī acchariyaṃ pavedesi. Tena vuttaṃ – ^14-16584

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1871]]

1871. "Yadi passanti pavane, dārakā phaline dume;
Tesaṃ phalānaṃ hetumhi, uparodanti dārakā. ^14-16585

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1872]]

1872. "Rodante dārake disvā, ubbiddhā vipulā dumā;
Sayamevonamitvāna, upagacchanti dārake. ^14-16586

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1873]]

1873. "Idaṃ accherakaṃ disvā, abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ;
Sādhukāraṃ pavattesi, maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā. ^14-16587

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1874]]

1874. "Accheraṃ vata lokasmiṃ, abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ;
Vessantarassa tejena, sayamevonatā dumā"ti. ^14-16588

Jetuttaranagarato suvaṇṇagiritālo nāma pabbato pañca yojanāni, tato kontimārā nāma nadī pañca yojanāni, tato añcaragiri nāma pabbato pañca yojanāni, tato dunniviṭṭhabrāhmaṇagāmo nāma pañca yojanāni, tato mātulanagaraṃ dasa yojanāni. Iti taṃ maggaṃ jetuttaranagarato tiṃsayojanaṃ hoti. Devatā taṃ maggaṃ saṃkhipiṃsu. Te ekadivaseneva mātulanagaraṃ pāpuṇiṃsu. Tena vuttaṃ – ^14-16589

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1875]]

1875. "Saṅkhipiṃsu pathaṃ yakkhā, anukampāya dārake;
Nikkhantadivaseneva, cetaraṭṭhaṃ upāgamu"nti. ^14-16590

Upagacchantā ca pana jetuttaranagarato pātarāsasamaye nikkhamitvā sāyanhasamaye cetaraṭṭhe mātulanagaraṃ pattā. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16591

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1876]]

1876. "Te gantvā dīghamaddhānaṃ, cetaraṭṭhaṃ upāgamuṃ;
Iddhaṃ phītaṃ janapadaṃ, bahumaṃsasurodana"nti. ^14-16592

Tadā mātulanagare saṭṭhi khattiyasahassāni vasanti. Mahāsatto antonagaraṃ apavisitvā nagaradvāreyeva sālāyaṃ nisīdi. Athassa maddī bodhisattassa pādesu rajaṃ puñchitvā pāde sambāhitvā "vessantarassa āgatabhāvaṃ jānāpessāmī"ti sālāto nikkhamitvā tassa cakkhupathe sālādvāre aṭṭhāsi. Nagaraṃ pavisantiyo ca nikkhamantiyo ca itthiyo taṃ disvā parivāresuṃ. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16593

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1877]]

1877. "Cetiyo parivāriṃsu, disvā lakkhaṇamāgataṃ;
Sukhumālī vata ayyā, pattikā paridhāvati. ^14-16594

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1878]]

1878. "Vayhāhi pariyāyitvā, sivikāya rathena ca;
Sājja maddī araññasmiṃ, pattikā paridhāvatī"ti. ^14-16595

Tattha **lakkhaṇamāgata**nti lakkhaṇasampannaṃ maddiṃ āgataṃ. **Paridhāvatī**ti evaṃ sukhumālī hutvā pattikāva vicarati. **Pariyāyitvā**ti jetuttaranagare vicaritvā. **Sivikāyā**ti suvaṇṇasivikāya. ^14-16596

Mahājano maddiñca vessantarañca dve putte cassa anāthāgamanena āgate disvā gantvā rājūnaṃ ācikkhi. Saṭṭhisahassā rājāno rodantā paridevantā tassa santikaṃ āgamaṃsu. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16597

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1879]]

1879. "Taṃ disvā cetapāmokkhā, rodamānā upāgamuṃ;
Kacci nu deva kusalaṃ, kacci deva anāmayaṃ;
Kacci pitā arogo te, sivīnañca anāmayaṃ. ^14-16598

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1880]]

1880. "Ko te balaṃ mahārāja, ko nu te rathamaṇḍalaṃ;
Anassako arathako, dīghamaddhānamāgato;
Kaccāmittehi pakato, anuppattosimaṃ disa"nti. ^14-16599

Tattha **disvā**ti dūratova passitvā. **Cetapāmokkhā**ti cetarājāno. **Upāgamu**nti upasaṅkamiṃsu. **Kusala**nti ārogyaṃ. **Anāmaya**nti niddukkhabhāvaṃ. **Ko te bala**nti kuhiṃ tava balakāyo. **Rathamaṇḍala**nti yenāsi rathena āgato, so kuhinti pucchanti. **Anassako**ti assavirahito. **Arathako**ti ayānako. **Dīghamaddhānamāgato**ti dīghamaggaṃ āgato. **Pakato**ti abhibhūto. ^14-16600

Atha nesaṃ mahāsatto attano āgatakāraṇaṃ kathento āha – ^14-16601

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1881]]

1881. "Kusalañceva me sammā, atho sammā anāmayaṃ;
Atho pitā arogo me, sivīnañca anāmayaṃ. ^14-16602

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1882]]

1882. "Ahañhi kuñjaraṃ dajjaṃ, īsādantaṃ urūḷhavaṃ;
Khettaññuṃ sabbayuddhānaṃ, sabbasetaṃ gajuttamaṃ. ^14-16603

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1883]]

1883. "Paṇḍukambalasañchannaṃ, pabhinnaṃ sattumaddanaṃ;
Dantiṃ savālabījaniṃ, setaṃ kelāsasādisaṃ. ^14-16604

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1884]]

1884. "Sasetacchattaṃ saupādheyyaṃ, sāthabbanaṃ sahatthipaṃ;
Aggayānaṃ rājavāhiṃ, brāhmaṇānaṃ adāsahaṃ. ^14-16605

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1885]]

1885. "Tasmiṃ me sivayo kuddhā, pitā cupahatomano;
Avaruddhasi maṃ rājā, vaṅkaṃ gacchāmi pabbataṃ;
Okāsaṃ sammā jānātha, vane yattha vasāmase"ti. ^14-16606

Tattha **tasmiṃ me**ti tasmiṃ kāraṇe mayhaṃ sivayo kuddhā. **Upahatomano**ti upahatacitto kuddhova maṃ raṭṭhā pabbājesi. **Yatthā**ti yasmiṃ vane mayaṃ vaseyyāma, tattha vasanokāsaṃ jānāthāti. ^14-16607

Te rājāno āhaṃsu – ^14-16608

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1886]]

1886. "Svāgataṃ te mahārāja, atho te adurāgataṃ;
Issarosi anuppatto, yaṃ idhatthi pavedaya. ^14-16609

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1887]]

1887. "Sākaṃ bhisaṃ madhuṃ maṃsaṃ, suddhaṃ sālīnamodanaṃ;
Paribhuñja mahārāja, pāhuno nosi āgato"ti. ^14-16610

Tattha **pavedayā**ti kathehi, sabbaṃ paṭiyādetvā dassāma. **Bhisa**nti bhisamūlaṃ, yaṃkiñci kandajātaṃ vā. ^14-16611

Vessantaro āha – ^14-16612

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1888]]

1888. "Paṭiggahitaṃ yaṃ dinnaṃ, sabbassa agghiyaṃ kataṃ;
Avaruddhasi maṃ rājā, vaṅkaṃ gacchāmi pabbataṃ;
Okāsaṃ sammā jānātha, vane yattha vasāmase"ti. ^14-16613

Tattha **paṭiggahita**nti sabbametaṃ tumhehi dinnaṃ mayā ca paṭiggahitameva hotu, sabbassa tumhehi mayhaṃ agghiyaṃ nivedanaṃ kataṃ. Rājā pana maṃ avaruddhasi raṭṭhā pabbājesi, tasmā vaṅkameva gamissāmi, tasmiṃ me araññe vasanaṭṭhānaṃ jānāthāti. ^14-16614

Te rājāno āhaṃsu – ^14-16615

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1889]]

1889. "Idheva tāva acchassu, cetaraṭṭhe rathesabha;
Yāva cetā gamissanti, rañño santika yācituṃ. ^14-16616

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1890]]

1890. "Nijjhāpetuṃ mahārājaṃ, sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhanaṃ;
Taṃ taṃ cetā purakkhatvā, patītā laddhapaccayā;
Parivāretvāna gacchanti, evaṃ jānāhi khattiyā"ti. ^14-16617

Tattha **rañño santika yācitu**nti rañño santikaṃ yācanatthāya gamissanti. **Nijjhāpetu**nti tumhākaṃ niddosabhāvaṃ jānāpetuṃ. **Laddhapaccayā**ti laddhapatiṭṭhā. **Gacchantī**ti gamissanti. ^14-16618

Mahāsatto āha – ^14-16619

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1891]]

1891. "Mā vo ruccittha gamanaṃ, rañño santika yācituṃ;
Nijjhāpetuṃ mahārājaṃ, rājāpi tattha nissaro. ^14-16620

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1892]]

1892. "Accuggatā hi sivayo, balaggā negamā ca ye;
Te vidhaṃsetumicchanti, rājānaṃ mama kāraṇā"ti. ^14-16621

Tattha **tatthā**ti tasmiṃ mama niddosabhāvaṃ nijjhāpane rājāpi anissaro. **Accuggatā**ti atikuddhā. **Balaggā**ti balakāyā. **Vidhaṃsetu**nti rajjato nīharituṃ. **Rājāna**nti rājānampi. ^14-16622

Te rājāno āhaṃsu – ^14-16623

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1893]]

1893. "Sace esā pavattettha, raṭṭhasmiṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhana;
Idheva rajjaṃ kārehi, cetehi parivārito. ^14-16624

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1894]]

1894. "Iddhaṃ phītañcidaṃ raṭṭhaṃ, iddho janapado mahā;
Matiṃ karohi tvaṃ deva, rajjassa manusāsitu"nti. ^14-16625

Tattha **sace esā pavattetthā**ti sace etasmiṃ raṭṭhe esā pavatti. **Rajjassa manusāsitu**nti rajjaṃ samanusāsituṃ, ayameva vā pāṭho. ^14-16626

Vessantaro āha – ^14-16627

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1895]]

1895. "Na me chando mati atthi, rajjassa anusāsituṃ;
Pabbājitassa raṭṭhasmā, cetaputtā suṇātha me. ^14-16628

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1896]]

1896. "Atuṭṭhā sivayo āsuṃ, balaggā negamā ca ye;
Pabbājitassa raṭṭhasmā, cetā rajjebhisecayuṃ. ^14-16629

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1897]]

1897. "Asammodiyampi vo assa, accantaṃ mama kāraṇā;
Sivīhi bhaṇḍanaṃ cāpi, viggaho me na ruccati. ^14-16630

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1898]]

1898. "Athassa bhaṇḍanaṃ ghoraṃ, sampahāro anappako;
Ekassa kāraṇā mayhaṃ, hiṃseyya bahuko jano. ^14-16631

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1899]]

1899. "Paṭiggahitaṃ yaṃ dinnaṃ, sabbassa agghiyaṃ kataṃ;
Avaruddhasi maṃ rājā, vaṅkaṃ gacchāmi pabbataṃ;
Okāsaṃ sammā jānātha, vane yattha vasāmase"ti. ^14-16632

Tattha **cetā rajjebhisecayu**nti cetaraṭṭhavāsino kira vessantaraṃ rajje abhisiñciṃsūti tumhākampi te atuṭṭhā āsuṃ. **Asammodiya**nti asāmaggiyaṃ. **Assā**ti bhaveyya. **Athassā**ti atha mayhaṃ ekassa kāraṇā tumhākaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ bhavissatīti. ^14-16633

Evaṃ mahāsatto anekapariyāyena yācitopi rajjaṃ na icchi. Athassa te cetarājāno mahantaṃ sakkāraṃ kariṃsu. So nagaraṃ pavisituṃ na icchi. Atha naṃ sālameva alaṅkaritvā sāṇiyā parikkhepaṃ katvā mahāsayanaṃ paññāpetvā sabbe ārakkhaṃ kariṃsu. So ekarattiṃ tehi saṅgahitārakkho sālāyaṃ sayitvā punadivase pātova nhatvā nānaggarasabhojanaṃ bhuñjitvā tehi parivuto nikkhami. Saṭṭhisahassā khattiyā tena saddhiṃ pannarasayojanamaggaṃ gantvā vanadvāre ṭhatvā purato pannarasayojanamaggaṃ ācikkhantā āhaṃsu – ^14-16634

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1900]]

1900. "Taggha te mayamakkhāma, yathāpi kusalā tathā;
Rājisī yattha sammanti, āhutaggī samāhitā. ^14-16635

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1901]]

1901. "Esa selo mahārāja, pabbato gandhamādano;
Yattha tvaṃ saha puttehi, saha bhariyāya cacchasi. ^14-16636

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1902]]

1902. "Taṃ cetā anusāsiṃsu, assunettā rudaṃmukhā;
Ito gaccha mahārāja, ujuṃ yenuttarāmukho. ^14-16637

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1903]]

1903. "Atha dakkhisi bhaddante, vepullaṃ nāma pabbataṃ;
Nānādumagaṇākiṇṇaṃ, sītacchāyaṃ manoramaṃ. ^14-16638

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1904]]

1904. "Tamatikkamma bhaddante, atha dakkhisi āpagaṃ;
Nadiṃ ketumatiṃ nāma, gambhīraṃ girigabbharaṃ. ^14-16639

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1905]]

1905. "Puthulomamacchākiṇṇaṃ, supatitthaṃ mahodakaṃ;
Tattha nhatvā pivitvā ca, assāsetvā saputtake. ^14-16640

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1906]]

1906. "Atha dakkhisi bhaddante, nigrodhaṃ madhupipphalaṃ;
Rammake sikhare jātaṃ, sītacchāyaṃ manoramaṃ. ^14-16641

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1907]]

1907. "Atha dakkhisi bhaddante, nāḷikaṃ nāma pabbataṃ;
Nānādijagaṇākiṇṇaṃ, selaṃ kimpurisāyutaṃ. ^14-16642

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1908]]

1908. "Tassa uttarapubbena, mucalindo nāma so saro;
Puṇḍarīkehi sañchanno, setasogandhikehi ca. ^14-16643

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1909]]

1909. "So vanaṃ meghasaṅkāsaṃ, dhuvaṃ haritasaddalaṃ;
Sīhovāmisapekkhīva, vanasaṇḍaṃ vigāhaya;
Puppharukkhehi sañchannaṃ, phalarukkhehi cūbhayaṃ. ^14-16644

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1910]]

1910. "Tattha bindussarā vaggū, nānāvaṇṇā bahū dijā;
Kūjantamupakūjanti, utusaṃpupphite dume. ^14-16645

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1911]]

1911. "Gantvā girividuggānaṃ, nadīnaṃ pabhavāni ca;
So dakkhisi pokkharaṇiṃ, karañjakakudhāyutaṃ. ^14-16646

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1912]]

1912. "Puthulomamacchākiṇṇaṃ, supatitthaṃ mahodakaṃ;
Samañca caturaṃsañca, sāduṃ appaṭigandhiyaṃ. ^14-16647

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1913]]

1913. "Tassā uttarapubbena, paṇṇasālaṃ amāpaya;
Paṇṇasālaṃ amāpetvā, uñchācariyāya īhathā"ti. ^14-16648

Tattha **rājisī**ti rājāno hutvā pabbajitā. **Samāhitā**ti ekaggacittā. **Esā**ti dakkhiṇahatthaṃ ukkhipitvā iminā pabbatapādena gacchathāti ācikkhantā vadanti. **Acchasī**ti vasissasi. **Āpaga**nti udakavāhanadiāvaṭṭaṃ. **Girigabbhara**nti girīnaṃ kucchito pavattaṃ. **Madhupipphala**nti madhuraphalaṃ. **Rammake**ti ramaṇīye. **Kimpurisāyuta**nti kimpurisehi āyutaṃ parikiṇṇaṃ. **Setasogandhīkehi cā**ti nānappakārehi setuppalehi ceva sogandhikehi ca sañchanno. **Sīhovāmisapekkhīvā**ti āmisaṃ pekkhanto sīho viya. ^14-16649

**Bindussarā**ti sampiṇḍitassarā. **Vaggū**ti madhurassarā. **Kūjantamupakūjantī**ti paṭhamaṃ kūjamānaṃ pakkhiṃ pacchā upakūjanti. **Utusaṃpupphite dume**ti utusamaye pupphite dume nilīyitvā kūjantaṃ upakūjanti. **So dakkhisī**ti so tvaṃ passissasīti attho. **Karañjakakudhāyuta**nti karañjarukkhehi ca kakudharukkhehi ca samparikiṇṇaṃ. **Appaṭigandhiya**nti paṭikūlagandhavirahitaṃ madhurodakaparikiṇṇaṃnānappakārapadumuppalādīhi sañchannaṃ. **Paṇṇasālaṃ amāpayā**ti paṇṇasālaṃ māpeyyāsi. **Amāpetvā**ti māpetvā. **Uñchācariyāya īhathā**ti atha tumhe, deva, uñchācariyāya yāpentā appamattā īhatha, āraddhavīriyā hutvā vihareyyāthāti attho. ^14-16650

Evaṃ te rājāno tassa pannarasayojanamaggaṃ ācikkhitvā taṃ uyyojetvā vessantarassa antarāyabhayassa vinodanatthaṃ "mā kocideva paccāmitto okāsaṃ labheyyā"ti cintetvā ekaṃ byattaṃ susikkhitaṃ cetaputtaṃ āmantetvā "tvaṃ gacchante ca āgacchante ca pariggaṇhāhī"ti vanadvāre ārakkhaṇatthāya ṭhapetvā sakanagaraṃ gamiṃsu. Vessantaropi saputtadāro gandhamādanapabbataṃ patvā, taṃ divasaṃ tattha vasitvā tato uttarābhimukho vepullapabbatapādena gantvā, ketumatiyā nāma nadiyā tīre nisīditvā vanacarakena dinnaṃ madhumaṃsaṃ khāditvā tassa suvaṇṇasūciṃ datvā tattha nhatvā pivitvā paṭippassaddhadaratho nadito uttaritvā sānupabbatasikhare ṭhitassa nigrodhassa mūle thokaṃ nisīditvā nigrodhaphalāni khāditvā uṭṭhāya gacchanto nāḷikaṃ nāma pabbataṃ patvā taṃ pariharanto mucalindasaraṃ gantvā sarassa tīrena pubbuttarakaṇṇaṃ patvā, ekapadikamaggena vanaghaṭaṃ pavisitvā taṃ atikkamma girividuggānaṃ nadippabhavānaṃ purato caturaṃsapokkharaṇiṃ pāpuṇi. ^14-16651

Tasmiṃ khaṇe sakko āvajjento "mahāsatto himavantaṃ paviṭṭho"ti ñatvā "tassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ laddhuṃ vaṭṭatī"ti cintetvā vissakammaṃ pakkosāpetvā "gaccha, tāta, tvaṃ vaṅkapabbatakujhacchimhi ramaṇīye ṭhāne assamapadaṃ māpetvā ehī"ti pesesi. So "sādhu, devā"ti devalokato otaritvā tattha dve paṇṇasālāyo dve caṅkame rattiṭṭhānadivāṭṭhānāni ca māpetvā caṅkamakoṭiyaṃ tesu tesu ṭhānesu nānāphaladhare rukkhe ca kadalivanāni ca dassetvā sabbe pabbajitaparikkhāre paṭiyādetvā "ye keci pabbajitukāmā, te ime gaṇhantū"ti akkharāni likhitvā amanusse ca bheravasadde migapakkhino ca paṭikkamāpetvā sakaṭṭhānameva gato. ^14-16652

Mahāsatto ekapadikamaggaṃ disvā "pabbajitānaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ bhavissatī"ti maddiñca putte ca assamapadadvāre ṭhapetvā assamapadaṃ pavisitvā akkharāni oloketvā "sakkenamhi diṭṭho"ti ñatvā paṇṇasālaṃ pavisitvā khaggañca dhanuñca apanetvā sāṭake omuñcitvā rattavākacīraṃ nivāsetvā ajinacammaṃ aṃse katvā jaṭāmaṇḍalaṃ bandhitvā isivesaṃ gahetvā kattaradaṇḍaṃ ādāya paṇṇasālato nikkhamitvā pabbajitasiriṃ samubbahanto "aho sukhaṃ, aho sukhaṃ, pabbajjā me adhigatā"ti udānaṃ udānetvā caṅkamaṃ āruyha aparāparaṃ caṅkamitvā paccekabuddhasadisena upasamena puttadārānaṃ santikaṃ agamāsi. Maddīpi mahāsattassa pādesu patitvā roditvā teneva saddhiṃ assamapadaṃ pavisitvā attano paṇṇasālaṃ gantvā isivesaṃ gaṇhi. Pacchā puttepi tāpasakumārake kariṃsu. Cattāro khattiyā vaṅkapabbatakucchimhi vasiṃsu. Atha maddī mahāsattaṃ varaṃ yāci "deva, tumhe phalāphalatthāya vanaṃ agantvā putte gahetvā idheva hotha, ahaṃ phalāphalaṃ āharissāmī"ti. Tato paṭṭhāya sā araññato phalāphalāni āharitvā tayo jane paṭijaggati. ^14-16653

Bodhisattopi taṃ varaṃ yāci "bhadde, maddi mayaṃ ito paṭṭhāya pabbajitā nāma, itthī ca nāma brahmacariyassa malaṃ, ito paṭṭhāya akāle mama santikaṃ mā āgacchāhī"ti. Sā "sādhū"ti sampaṭicchi. Mahāsattassa mettānubhāvena samantā tiyojane sabbe tiracchānāpi aññamaññaṃ mettacittaṃ paṭilabhiṃsu. Maddīdevīpi pātova uṭṭhāya pānīyaparibhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā mukhodakaṃ āharitvā dantakaṭṭhaṃ datvā assamapadaṃ sammajjitvā dve putte pitu santike ṭhapetvā pacchikhaṇittiaṅkusahatthā araññaṃ pavisitvā vanamūlaphalāphalāni ādāya pacchiṃ pūretvā sāyanhasamaye araññato āgantvā paṇṇasālāya phalāphalaṃ ṭhapetvā nhatvā putte nhāpesi. Atha cattāropi janā paṇṇasālādvāre nisīditvā phalāphalaṃ paribhuñjanti. Tato maddī putte gahetvā attano paṇṇasālaṃ pāvisi. Iminā niyāmena te pabbatakucchimhi satta māse vasiṃsūti. ^14-16654

Vanapavesanakaṇḍavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā. ^14-16655

##### Jūjakapabbavaṇṇanā ^14-22-10-5-0

Tadā kāliṅgaraṭṭhe dunniviṭṭhabrāhmaṇagāmavāsī jūjako nāma brāhmaṇo bhikkhācariyāya kahāpaṇasataṃ labhitvā ekasmiṃ brāhmaṇakule ṭhapetvā puna dhanapariyesanatthāya gato. Tasmiṃ cirāyante brāhmaṇakulā kahāpaṇasataṃ valañjetvā pacchā itarena āgantvā codiyamānā kahāpaṇe dātuṃ asakkontā amittatāpanaṃ nāma dhītaraṃ tassa adaṃsu. So taṃ ādāya kāliṅgaraṭṭhe dunniviṭṭhabrāhmaṇagāmaṃ gantvā vasi. Amittatāpanā sammā brāhmaṇaṃ paricarati. Atha aññe taruṇabrāhmaṇā tassā ācārasampattiṃ disvā "ayaṃ mahallakabrāhmaṇaṃ sammā paṭijaggati, tumhe pana amhesu kiṃ pamajjathā"ti attano attano bhariyāyo tajjenti. Tā "imaṃ amittatāpanaṃ imamhā gāmā palāpessāmā"ti nadītitthādīsu sannipatitvā taṃ paribhāsiṃsu. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16656

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1914]]

1914. "Ahu vāsī kaliṅgesu, jūjako nāma brāhmaṇo;
Tassāsi daharā bhariyā, nāmenāmittatāpanā. ^14-16657

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1915]]

1915. "Tā naṃ tattha gatāvocuṃ, nadiṃ udakahāriyā;
Thiyo naṃ paribhāsiṃsu, samāgantvā kutūhalā. ^14-16658

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1916]]

1916. "Amittā nūna te mātā, amitto nūna te pitā;
Ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu, evaṃ dahariyaṃ satiṃ. ^14-16659

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1917]]

1917. "Ahitaṃ vata te ñātī, mantayiṃsu rahogatā;
Ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu, evaṃ dahariyaṃ satiṃ. ^14-16660

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1918]]

1918. "Amittā vata te ñātī, mantayiṃsu rahogatā;
Ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu, evaṃ dahariyaṃ satiṃ. ^14-16661

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1919]]

1919. "Dukkaṭaṃ vata te ñātī, mantayiṃsu rahogatā;
Ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu, evaṃ dahariyaṃ satiṃ. ^14-16662

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1920]]

1920. "Pāpakaṃ vata te ñātī, mantayiṃsu rahogatā;
Ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu, evaṃ dahariyaṃ satiṃ. ^14-16663

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1921]]

1921. "Amanāpaṃ vata te ñātī, mantayiṃsu rahogatā;
Ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu, evaṃ dahariyaṃ satiṃ. ^14-16664

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1922]]

1922. "Amanāpavāsaṃ vasi, jiṇṇena patinā saha;
Yā tvaṃ vasasi jiṇṇassa, mataṃ te jīvitā varaṃ. ^14-16665

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1923]]

1923. "Na hi nūna tuyhaṃ kalyāṇi, pitā mātā ca sobhane;
Aññaṃ bhattāraṃ vindiṃsu, ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu;
Evaṃ dahariyaṃ satiṃ. ^14-16666

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1924]]

1924. "Duyiṭṭhaṃ te navamiyaṃ, akataṃ aggihuttakaṃ;
Ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu, evaṃ dahariyaṃ satiṃ. ^14-16667

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1925]]

1925. "Samaṇe brāhmaṇe nūna, brahmacariyaparāyaṇe;
Sā tvaṃ loke abhisapi, sīlavante bahussute;
Yā tvaṃ vasasi jiṇṇassa, evaṃ dahariyā satī. ^14-16668

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1926]]

1926. "Na dukkhaṃ ahinā daṭṭhaṃ, na dukkhaṃ sattiyā hataṃ;
Tañca dukkhañca tibbañca, yaṃ passe jiṇṇakaṃ patiṃ. ^14-16669

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1927]]

1927. "Natthi khiḍḍā natthi rati, jiṇṇena patinā saha;
Natthi ālāpasallāpo, jagghitampi na sobhati. ^14-16670

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1928]]

1928. "Yadā ca daharo daharā, mantayanti rahogatā;
Sabbesaṃ sokā nassanti, ye keci hadayassitā. ^14-16671

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1929]]

1929. "Daharā tvaṃ rūpavatī, purisānaṃbhipatthitā;
Gaccha ñātikule accha, kiṃ jiṇṇo ramayissatī"ti. ^14-16672

Tattha **ahū**ti ahosi. **Vāsī kaliṅgesū**ti kāliṅgaraṭṭhesu dunniviṭṭhabrāhmaṇagāmavāsī. **Tā naṃ tattha gatāvocu**nti tattha gāme tā itthiyo nadītitthe udakahārikā hutvā gatā naṃ avocuṃ. **Thiyo naṃ paribhāsiṃsū**ti itthiyo na aññaṃ kiñci avocuṃ, atha kho naṃ paribhāsiṃsu. **Kutūhalā**ti kotūhalajātā viya hutvā. **Samāgantvā**ti samantā parikkhipitvā. **Dahariyaṃ sati**nti dahariṃ taruṇiṃ sobhaggappattaṃ samānaṃ. **Jiṇṇassā**ti jarājiṇṇassa gehe. **Duyiṭṭhaṃ te navamiya**nti tava navamiyaṃ yāgaṃ duyiṭṭhaṃ bhavissati, so te yāgapiṇḍo paṭhamaṃ mahallakakākena gahito bhavissati. "Duyiṭṭhā te navamiyā"tipi pāṭho, navamiyā tayā duyiṭṭhā bhavissatīti attho. **Akataṃ aggihuttaka**nti aggijuhanampi tayā akataṃ bhavissati. **Abhisapī**ti samaṇabrāhmaṇe samitapāpe vā bāhitapāpe vā akkosi. Tassa te pāpassa idaṃ phalanti adhippāyeneva āhaṃsu. **Jagghitampi na sobhatī**ti khaṇḍadante vivaritvā hasantassa mahallakassa hasitampi na sobhati. **Sabbesaṃ sokā nassantī**ti sabbe etesaṃ sokā vinassanti. **Kiṃ jiṇṇo**ti ayaṃ jiṇṇo taṃ pañcahi kāmaguṇehi kathaṃ ramayissatīti. ^14-16673

Sā tāsaṃ santikā paribhāsaṃ labhitvā udakaghaṭaṃ ādāya rodamānā gharaṃ gantvā "kiṃ bhoti rodasī"ti brāhmaṇena puṭṭhā tassa ārocentī imaṃ gāthamāha – ^14-16674

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1930]]

1930. "Na te brāhmaṇa gacchāmi, nadiṃ udakahāriyā;
Thiyo maṃ paribhāsanti, tayā jiṇṇena brāhmaṇā"ti. ^14-16675

Tassattho – brāhmaṇa, tayā jiṇṇena maṃ itthiyo paribhāsanti, tasmā ito paṭṭhāya tava udakahārikā hutvā nadiṃ na gacchāmīti. ^14-16676

Jūjako āha – ^14-16677

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1931]]

1931. "Mā me tvaṃ akarā kammaṃ, mā me udakamāhari;
Ahaṃ udakamāhissaṃ, mā bhoti kupitā ahū"ti. ^14-16678

Tattha **udakamāhissa**nti bhoti ahaṃ udakaṃ āharissāmi. ^14-16679

Brāhmaṇī āha – ^14-16680

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1932]]

1932. "Nāhaṃ tamhi kule jātā, yaṃ tvaṃ udakamāhare;
Evaṃ brāhmaṇa jānāhi, na te vacchāmahaṃ ghare. ^14-16681

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1933]]

1933. "Sace me dāsaṃ dāsiṃ vā, nānayissasi brāhmaṇa;
Evaṃ brāhmaṇa jānāhi, na te vacchāmi santike"ti. ^14-16682

Tattha **nāha**nti brāhmaṇa, yamhi kule sāmiko kammaṃ karoti, nāhaṃ tattha jātā. **Yaṃ tva**nti tasmā yaṃ udakaṃ tvaṃ āharissasi, na mayhaṃ tena attho. ^14-16683

Jūjako āha – ^14-16684

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1934]]

1934. "Natthi me sippaṭhānaṃ vā, dhanaṃ dhaññañca brāhmaṇi;
Kutohaṃ dāsaṃ dāsiṃ vā, ānayissāmi bhotiyā;
Ahaṃ bhotiṃ upaṭṭhissaṃ, mā bhoti kupitā ahū"ti. ^14-16685

Brāhmaṇī āha – ^14-16686

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1935]]

1935. "Ehi te ahamakkhissaṃ, yathā me vacanaṃ sutaṃ;
Esa vessantaro rājā, vaṅke vasati pabbate. ^14-16687

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1936]]

1936. "Taṃ tvaṃ gantvāna yācassu, dāsaṃ dāsiñca brāhmaṇa;
So te dassati yācito, dāsaṃ dāsiñca khattiyo"ti. ^14-16688

Tattha **ehi te ahamakkhissa**nti ahaṃ te ācikkhissāmi. Idaṃ sā devatādhiggahitā hutvā āha. ^14-16689

Jūjako āha – ^14-16690

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1937]]

1937. "Jiṇṇohamasmi dubbalo, dīgho caddhā suduggamo;
Mā bhoti paridevesi, mā ca tvaṃ vimanā ahu;
Ahaṃ bhotiṃ upaṭṭhissaṃ, mā bhoti kupitā ahū"ti. ^14-16691

Tattha **jiṇṇohamasmī**ti bhadde, ahaṃ jiṇṇo amhi, kathaṃ gamissāmīti. ^14-16692

Brāhmaṇī āha – ^14-16693

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1938]]

1938. "Yathā agantvā saṅgāmaṃ, ayuddhova parājito;
Evameva tuvaṃ brahme, agantvāva parājito. ^14-16694

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1939]]

1939. "Sace me dāsaṃ dāsiṃ vā, nānayissasi brāhmaṇa;
Evaṃ brāhmaṇa jānāhi, na te vacchāmahaṃ ghare;
Amanāpaṃ te karissāmi, taṃ te dukkhaṃ bhavissati. ^14-16695

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1940]]

1940. "Nakkhatte utupubbesu, yadā maṃ dakkhisilaṅkataṃ;
Aññehi saddhiṃ ramamānaṃ, taṃ te dukkhaṃ bhavissati. ^14-16696

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1941]]

1941. "Adassanena mayhaṃ te, jiṇṇassa paridevato;
Bhiyyo vaṅkā ca palitā, bahū hessanti brāhmaṇā"ti. ^14-16697

Tattha **amanāpaṃ te**ti vessantarassa santikaṃ gantvā dāsaṃ vā dāsiṃ vā anāharantassa tava aruccanakaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi. **Nakkhatte utupubbesū**ti nakkhattayogavasena vā channaṃ utūnaṃ tassa tassa pubbavasena vā pavattesu chaṇesu. ^14-16698

Taṃ sutvā brāhmaṇo bhīto ahosi. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16699

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1942]]

1942. "Tato so brāhmaṇo bhīto, brāhmaṇiyā vasānugo;
Aṭṭito kāmarāgena, brāhmaṇiṃ etadabravi. ^14-16700

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1943]]

1943. "Pātheyyaṃ me karohi tvaṃ, saṃkulyā saguḷāni ca;
Madhupiṇḍikā ca sukatāyo, sattubhattañca brāhmaṇi. ^14-16701

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1944]]

1944. "Ānayissaṃ methunake, ubho dāsakumārake;
Te taṃ paricarissanti, rattindivamatanditā"ti. ^14-16702

Tattha **aṭṭito**ti upadduto pīḷito. **Saguḷāni cā**ti saguḷapūve ca. **Sattubhatta**nti baddhasattuabaddhasattuñceva puṭabhattañca. **Methunake**ti jātigottakulapadesehi sadise. **Dāsakumārake**ti tava dāsatthāya kumārake. ^14-16703

Sā khippaṃ pātheyyaṃ paṭiyādetvā brāhmaṇassa ārocesi. So gehe dubbalaṭṭhānaṃ thiraṃ katvā dvāraṃ saṅkharitvā araññā dārūni āharitvā ghaṭena udakaṃ āharitvā gehe sabbabhājanāni pūretvā tattheva tāpasavesaṃ gahetvā "bhadde, ito paṭṭhāya vikāle mā nikkhami, yāva mamāgamanā appamattā hohī"ti ovaditvā upāhanaṃ āruyha pātheyyapasibbakaṃ aṃse laggetvā amittatāpanaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā assupuṇṇehi nettehi roditvā pakkāmi. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16704

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1945]]

1945. "Idaṃ vatvā brahmabandhu, paṭimuñci upāhanā;
Tato so mantayitvāna, bhariyaṃ katvā padakkhiṇaṃ. ^14-16705

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1946]]

1946. "Pakkāmi so ruṇṇamukho, brāhmaṇo sahitabbato;
Sivīnaṃ nagaraṃ phītaṃ, dāsapariyesanaṃ cara"nti. ^14-16706

Tattha **ruṇṇamukho**ti rudaṃmukho. **Sahitabbato**ti samādinnavato, gahitatāpasavesoti attho. **Cara**nti dāsapariyesanaṃ caranto sivīnaṃ nagaraṃ ārabbha pakkāmi. ^14-16707

So taṃ nagaraṃ gantvā sannipatitaṃ janaṃ "vessantaro kuhi"nti pucchati. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16708

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1947]]

1947. "So tattha gantvā avaca, ye tatthāsuṃ samāgatā;
Kuhiṃ vessantaro rājā, kattha passemu khattiyaṃ. ^14-16709

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1948]]

1948. "Te janā taṃ avaciṃsu, ye tatthāsuṃ samāgatā;
Tumhehi brahme pakato, atidānena khattiyo;
Pabbājito sakā raṭṭhā, vaṅke vasati pabbate. ^14-16710

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1949]]

1949. "Tumhehi brahme pakato, atidānena khattiyo;
Ādāya puttadārañca, vaṅke vasati pabbate"ti. ^14-16711

Tattha **pakato**ti upadduto pīḷito attano nagare vasituṃ alabhitvā idāni vaṅkapabbate vasati. ^14-16712

Evaṃ "tumhe amhākaṃ rājānaṃ nāsetvā punapi āgatā idha tiṭṭhathā"ti te leḍḍudaṇḍādihatthā brāhmaṇaṃ anubandhiṃsu. So devatādhiggahito hutvā vaṅkapabbatamaggameva gaṇhi. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16713

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1950]]

1950. "So codito brāhmaṇiyā, brāhmaṇo kāmagiddhimā;
Aghaṃ taṃ paṭisevittha, vane vāḷamigākiṇṇe;
Khaggadīpinisevite. ^14-16714

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1951]]

1951. "Ādāya beḷuvaṃ daṇḍaṃ, aggihuttaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ;
So pāvisi brahāraññaṃ, yattha assosi kāmadaṃ. ^14-16715

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1952]]

1952. "Taṃ paviṭṭhaṃ brahāraññaṃ, kokā naṃ parivārayuṃ;
Vikkandi so vippanaṭṭho, dūre panthā apakkami. ^14-16716

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1953]]

1953. "Tato so brāhmaṇo gantvā, bhogaluddho asaññato;
Vaṅkassorohaṇe naṭṭhe, imā gāthā abhāsathā"ti. ^14-16717

Tattha **aghaṃ ta**nti taṃ mahājanena anubandhanadukkhañceva vanapariyogāhanadukkhañca. **Aggihutta**nti aggijuhanakaṭacchuṃ. **Kokā naṃ parivārayu**nti so hi araññaṃ pavisitvā vaṅkapabbatagāmimaggaṃ ajānanto maggamūḷho hutvā araññe vicari. Atha naṃ ārakkhaṇatthāya nisinnassa cetaputtassa sunakhā parivārayiṃsūti attho. **Vikkandi so**ti so ekarukkhaṃ āruyha mahantena ravena kandi. **Vippanaṭṭho**ti vinaṭṭhamaggo. **Dūre panthā**ti vaṅkapabbatagāmipanthato dūre pakkāmi. **Bhogaluddho**ti bhogaratto. **Asaññato**ti dussīlo. **Vaṅkassorohaṇe naṭṭhe**ti vaṅkapabbatassa gamanamagge vinaṭṭhe. ^14-16718

So sunakhehi parivārito rukkhe nisinnova imā gāthā abhāsatha – ^14-16719

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1954]]

1954. "Ko rājaputtaṃ nisabhaṃ, jayantamaparājitaṃ;
Bhaye khemassa dātāraṃ, ko me vessantaraṃ vidū. ^14-16720

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1955]]

1955. "Yo yācataṃ patiṭṭhāsi, bhūtānaṃ dharaṇīriva;
Dharaṇūpamaṃ mahārājaṃ, ko me vessantaraṃ vidū. ^14-16721

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1956]]

1956. "Yo yācataṃ gatī āsi, savantīnaṃva sāgaro;
Sāgarūpamaṃ mahārājaṃ, ko me vessantaraṃ vidū. ^14-16722

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1957]]

1957. "Kalyāṇatitthaṃ sucimaṃ, sītūdakaṃ manoramaṃ;
Puṇḍarīkehi sañchannaṃ, yuttaṃ kiñjakkhareṇunā;
Rahadūpamaṃ mahārājaṃ, ko me vessantaraṃ vidū. ^14-16723

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1958]]

1958. "Assatthaṃva pathe jātaṃ, sītacchāyaṃ manoramaṃ;
Santānaṃ visametāraṃ, kilantānaṃ paṭiggahaṃ;
Tathūpamaṃ mahārājaṃ, ko me vessantaraṃ vidū. ^14-16724

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1959]]

1959. "Nigrodhaṃva pathe jātaṃ, sītacchāyaṃ manoramaṃ;
Santānaṃ visametāraṃ, kilantānaṃ paṭiggahaṃ;
Tathūpamaṃ mahārājaṃ, ko me vessantaraṃ vidū. ^14-16725

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1960]]

1960. "Ambaṃ iva pathe jātaṃ, sītacchāyaṃ manoramaṃ;
Santānaṃ visametāraṃ, kilantānaṃ paṭiggahaṃ;
Tathūpamaṃ mahārājaṃ, ko me vessantaraṃ vidū. ^14-16726

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1961]]

1961. "Sālaṃ iva pathe jātaṃ, sītacchāyaṃ manoramaṃ;
Santānaṃ visametāraṃ, kilantānaṃ paṭiggahaṃ;
Tathūpamaṃ mahārājaṃ, ko me vessantaraṃ vidū. ^14-16727

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1962]]

1962. "Dumaṃ iva pathe jātaṃ, sītacchāyaṃ manoramaṃ;
Santānaṃ visametāraṃ, kilantānaṃ paṭiggahaṃ;
Tathūpamaṃ mahārājaṃ, ko me vessantaraṃ vidū. ^14-16728

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1963]]

1963. "Evañca me vilapato, paviṭṭhassa brahāvane;
Ahaṃ jānanti yo vajjā, nandiṃ so janaye mama. ^14-16729

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1964]]

1964. "Evañca me vilapato, paviṭṭhassa brahāvane;
Ahaṃ jānanti yo vajjā, tāya so ekavācāya;
Pasave puññaṃ anappaka"nti. ^14-16730

Tattha **jayanta**nti maccheracittaṃ vijayantaṃ. **Ko me vessantaraṃ vidū**ti ko mayhaṃ vessantaraṃ ācikkheyyāti vadati. **Patiṭṭhāsī**ti patiṭṭhā āsi. **Santāna**nti parissantānaṃ. **Kilantāna**nti maggakilantānaṃ. **Paṭiggaha**nti paṭiggāhakaṃ patiṭṭhābhūtaṃ. **Ahaṃ jānanti yo vajjā**ti ahaṃ vessantarassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ jānāmīti yo vadeyyāti attho. ^14-16731

Tassa taṃ paridevasaddaṃ sutvā ārakkhaṇatthāya ṭhapito cetaputto migaluddako hutvā araññe vicaranto "ayaṃ brāhmaṇo vessantarassa vasanaṭṭhānatthāya paridevati, na kho panesa dhammatāya āgato, maddiṃ vā dārake vā yācissati, idheva naṃ māressāmī"ti tassa santikaṃ gantvā "brāhmaṇa, na te jīvitaṃ dassāmī"ti dhanuṃ āropetvā ākaḍḍhitvā tajjesi. Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā āha – ^14-16732

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1965]]

1965. "Tassa ceto paṭissosi, araññe luddako caraṃ;
Tumhehi brahme pakato, atidānena khattiyo;
Pabbājito sakā raṭṭhā, vaṅke vasati pabbate. ^14-16733

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1966]]

1966. "Tumhehi brahme pakato, atidānena khattiyo;
Ādāya puttadārañca, vaṅke vasati pabbate. ^14-16734

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1967]]

1967. "Akiccakārī dummedho, raṭṭhā pavanamāgato;
Rājaputtaṃ gavesanto, bako macchamivodake. ^14-16735

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1968]]

1968. "Tassa tyāhaṃ na dassāmi, jīvitaṃ idha brāhmaṇa;
Ayañhi te mayā nunno, saro pissati lohitaṃ. ^14-16736

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1969]]

1969. "Siro te vajjhayitvāna, hadayaṃ chetvā sabandhanaṃ;
Panthasakuṇaṃ yajissāmi, tuyhaṃ maṃsena brāhmaṇa. ^14-16737

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1970]]

1970. "Tuyhaṃ maṃsena medena, matthakena ca brāhmaṇa;
Āhutiṃ paggahessāmi, chetvāna hadayaṃ tava. ^14-16738

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1971]]

1971. "Taṃ me suyiṭṭhaṃ suhutaṃ, tuyhaṃ maṃsena brāhmaṇa;
Na ca tvaṃ rājaputtassa, bhariyaṃ putte ca nessasī"ti. ^14-16739

Tattha **akiccakārī**ti tvaṃ akiccakārako. **Dummedho**ti nippañño. **Raṭṭhā pavanamāgato**ti raṭṭhato mahāraññaṃ āgato. **Saro pissatī**ti ayaṃ saro tava lohitaṃ pivissati. **Vajjhayitvānā**ti taṃ māretvā rukkhā patitassa te sīsaṃ tālaphalaṃ viya luñcitvā sabandhanaṃ hadayamaṃsaṃ chinditvā panthadevatāya panthasakuṇaṃ nāma yajissāmi. **Na ca tva**nti evaṃ sante na tvaṃ rājaputtassa bhariyaṃ vā putte vā nessasīti. ^14-16740

So tassa vacanaṃ sutvā maraṇabhayatajjito musāvādaṃ kathento āha – ^14-16741

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1972]]

1972. "Avajjho brāhmaṇo dūto, cetaputta suṇohi me;
Tasmā hi dūtaṃ na hanti, esa dhammo sanantano. ^14-16742

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1973]]

1973. "Nijjhattā sivayo sabbe, pitā naṃ daṭṭhumicchati;
Mātā ca dubbalā tassa, acirā cakkhūni jīyare. ^14-16743

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1974]]

1974. "Tesāhaṃ pahito dūto, cetaputta suṇohi me;
Rājaputtaṃ nayissāmi, yadi jānāsi saṃsa me"ti. ^14-16744

Tattha **nijjhattā**ti saññattā. **Acirā cakkhūni jīyare**ti niccarodanena na cirasseva cakkhūni jīyissanti. ^14-16745

Tadā cetaputto "vessantaraṃ kira ānetuṃ āgato"ti somanassappatto hutvā sunakhe bandhitvā ṭhapetvā brāhmaṇaṃ otāretvā sākhāsanthare nisīdāpetvā bhojanaṃ datvā imaṃ gāthamāha – ^14-16746

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1975]]

1975. "Piyassa me piyo dūto, puṇṇapattaṃ dadāmi te;
Imañca madhuno tumbaṃ, migasatthiñca brāhmaṇa;
Tañca te desamakkhissaṃ, yattha sammati kāmado"ti. ^14-16747

Tattha **piyassa me**ti mama piyassa vessantarassa tvaṃ piyo dūto. **Puṇṇapatta**nti tava ajjhāsayapūraṇaṃ puṇṇapattaṃ dadāmīti. ^14-16748

Jūjakapabbavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā. ^14-16749

##### Cūḷavanavaṇṇanā ^14-22-10-6-0

Evaṃ cetaputto brāhmaṇaṃ bhojetvā pātheyyatthāya tassa madhuno tumbañceva pakkamigasatthiñca datvā magge ṭhatvā dakkhiṇahatthaṃ ukkhipitvā mahāsattassa vasanokāsaṃ ācikkhanto āha – ^14-16750

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1976]]

1976. "Esa selo mahābrahme, pabbato gandhamādano;
Yattha vessantaro rājā, saha puttehi sammati. ^14-16751

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1977]]

1977. "Dhārento brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ, āsadañca masaṃ jaṭaṃ;
Cammavāsī chamā seti, jātavedaṃ namassati. ^14-16752

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1978]]

1978. "Ete nīlā padissanti, nānāphaladharā dumā;
Uggatā abbhakūṭāva, nīlā añjanapabbatā. ^14-16753

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1979]]

1979. "Dhavassakaṇṇā khadirā, sālā phandanamāluvā;
Sampavedhanti vātena, sakiṃ pītāva māṇavā. ^14-16754

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1980]]

1980. "Upari dumapariyāyesu, saṅgītiyova suyyare;
Najjuhā kokilasaṅghā, sampatanti dumā dumaṃ. ^14-16755

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1981]]

1981. "Avhayanteva gacchantaṃ, sākhāpattasamīritā;
Ramayanteva āgantaṃ, modayanti nivāsinaṃ;
Yattha vessantaro rājā, saha puttehi sammati. ^14-16756

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1982]]

1982. "Dhārento brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ, āsadañca masaṃ jaṭaṃ;
Cammavāsī chamā seti, jātavedaṃ namassatī"ti. ^14-16757

Tattha **gandhamādano**ti esa gandhamādanapabbato, etassa pādena uttarābhimukho gacchanto yattha sakkadattiye assamapade vessantaro rājā saha puttadārehi vasati, taṃ passissasīti attho. **Brāhmaṇavaṇṇa**nti seṭṭhapabbajitavesaṃ. **Āsadañca masaṃ jaṭa**nti ākaḍḍhitvā phalānaṃ gahaṇatthaṃ aṅkusañca aggijuhanakaṭacchuñca jaṭāmaṇḍalañca dhārento. **Cammavāsī**ti ajinacammadharo. **Chamā setī**ti pathaviyaṃ paṇṇasanthare sayati. **Dhavassakaṇṇā khadirā**ti dhavā ca assakaṇṇā ca khadirā ca. **Sakiṃ pītāva māṇavā**ti ekavārameva pītā surāsoṇḍā viya. **Upari dumapariyāyesū**ti rukkhasākhāsu. **Saṅgītiyova suyyare**ti nānāsakuṇānaṃ vassantānaṃ saddā dibbasaṅgītiyo viya suyyare. **Najjuhā**ti najjuhasakuṇā. **Sampatantī**ti vikūjantā vicaranti. **Sākhāpattasamīritā**ti sākhānaṃ pattehi saṅghaṭṭitā hutvā vikūjantā sakuṇā, vātena samīritā pattasākhāyeva vā. **Āganta**nti āgacchantaṃ janaṃ. **Yatthā**ti yasmiṃ assame vessantaro vasati, tattha gantvā imaṃ assamapadasampattiṃ passissasīti. ^14-16758

Tato uttaripi assamapadaṃ vaṇṇento āha – ^14-16759

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1983]]

1983. "Ambā kapitthā panasā, sālā jambū vibhītakā;
Harītakī āmalakā, assatthā badarāni ca. ^14-16760

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1984]]

1984. "Cārutimbarukkhā cettha, nigrodhā ca kapitthanā;
Madhumadhukā thevanti, nīce pakkā cudumbarā. ^14-16761

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1985]]

1985. "Pārevatā bhaveyyā ca, muddikā ca madhutthikā;
Madhuṃ anelakaṃ tattha, sakamādāya bhuñjare. ^14-16762

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1986]]

1986. "Aññettha pupphitā ambā, aññe tiṭṭhanti dovilā;
Aññe āmā ca pakkā ca, bhekavaṇṇā tadūbhayaṃ. ^14-16763

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1987]]

1987. "Athettha heṭṭhā puriso, ambapakkāni gaṇhati;
Āmāni ceva pakkāni, vaṇṇagandharasuttame. ^14-16764

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1988]]

1988. "Ateva me acchariyaṃ, hīṅkāro paṭibhāti maṃ;
Devānamiva āvāso, sobhati nandanūpamo. ^14-16765

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1989]]

1989. "Vibhedikā nāḷikerā, khajjurīnaṃ brahāvane;
Mālāva ganthitā ṭhanti, dhajaggāneva dissare;
Nānāvaṇṇehi pupphehi, nabhaṃ tārācitāmiva. ^14-16766

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1990]]

1990. "Kuṭajī kuṭṭhatagarā, pāṭaliyo ca pupphitā;
Punnāgā giripunnāgā, koviḷārā ca pupphitā. ^14-16767

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1991]]

1991. "Uddālakā somarukkhā, agaruphalliyā bahū;
Puttajīvā ca kakudhā, asanā cettha pupphitā. ^14-16768

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1992]]

1992. "Kuṭajā salaḷā nīpā, kosambā labujā dhavā;
Sālā ca pupphitā tattha, palālakhalasannibhā. ^14-16769

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1993]]

1993. "Tassāvidūre pokkharaṇī, bhūmibhāge manorame;
Padumuppalasañchannā, devānamiva nandane. ^14-16770

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1994]]

1994. "Athettha puppharasamattā, kokilā mañjubhāṇikā;
Abhinādenti pavanaṃ, utusampupphite dume. ^14-16771

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1995]]

1995. "Bhassanti makarandehi, pokkhare pokkhare madhū;
Athettha vātā vāyanti, dakkhiṇā atha pacchimā;
Padumakiñjakkhareṇūhi, okiṇṇo hoti assamo. ^14-16772

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1996]]

1996. "Thūlā siṅghāṭakā cettha, saṃsādiyā pasādiyā;
Macchakacchapabyāviddhā, bahū cettha mupayānakā;
Madhuṃ bhisehi savati, khīrasappi muḷālibhi. ^14-16773

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1997]]

1997. "Surabhī taṃ vanaṃ vāti, nānāgandhasamoditaṃ;
Sammaddateva gandhena, pupphasākhāhi taṃ vanaṃ;
Bhamarā pupphagandhena, samantā mabhināditā. ^14-16774

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1998]]

1998. "Athettha sakuṇā santi, nānāvaṇṇā bahū dijā;
Modanti saha bhariyāhi, aññamaññaṃ pakūjino. ^14-16775

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-1999]]

1999. "Nandikā jīvaputtā ca, jīvaputtā piyā ca no;
Piyā puttā piyā nandā, dijā pokkharaṇīgharā. ^14-16776

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2000]]

2000. "Mālāva ganthitā ṭhanti, dhajaggāneva dissare;
Nānāvaṇṇehi pupphehi, kusaleheva suganthitā;
Yattha vessantaro rājā, saha puttehi sammati. ^14-16777

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2001]]

2001. "Dhārento brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ, āsadañca masaṃ jaṭaṃ;
Cammavāsī chamā seti, jātavedaṃ namassatī"ti. ^14-16778

Tattha **cārutimbarukkhā**ti suvaṇṇatimbarukkhā. **Madhumadhukā**ti madhurasā madhukā. **Thevantī**ti virocanti. **Pārevatā**ti pārevatapādasadisā rukkhā. **Bhaveyyā**ti dīghaphalā kadaliyo. **Madhutthikā**ti madhuttheve paggharantiyo, madhuratāya vā madhutthevasadisā. **Sakamādāyā**ti taṃ sayameva gahetvā paribhuñjanti. **Dovilā**ti patitapupphapattā sañjāyamānaphalā. **Bhekavaṇṇā tadūbhaya**nti te ubhopi āmā ca pakkā ca maṇḍūkapiṭṭhivaṇṇāyeva. **Athettha heṭṭhā puriso**ti atha ettha assame tesaṃ ambānaṃ heṭṭhā ṭhitakova puriso ambaphalāni gaṇhāti, ārohaṇakiccaṃ natthi. **Vaṇṇagandharasuttame**ti etehi vaṇṇādīhi uttamāni. ^14-16779

**Ateva me acchariya**nti ativiya me acchariyaṃ. **Hiṅkāro**ti hinti karaṇaṃ. **Vibhedikā**ti tālā. **Mālāva ganthitā**ti supupphitarukkhānaṃ upari ganthitā mālā viya pupphāni tiṭṭhanti. **Dhajaggāneva dissare**ti tāni rukkhāni alaṅkatadhajaggāni viya dissanti. **Kuṭajī kuṭṭhatagarā**ti kuṭaji nāmekā rukkhajāti kuṭṭhagacchā ca tagaragacchā ca. **Giripunnāgā**ti mahāpunnāgā. **Koviḷārā**ti koviḷārarukkhā nāma. **Uddālakā**ti uddālarukkhā. **Somarukkhā**ti pītapupphavaṇṇā rājarukkhā. **Phalliyā**ti phalliyarukkhā nāma. **Puttajīvā**ti mahānigrodhā. **Labujā**ti labujarukkhā nāma. **Palālakhalasannibhā**ti tesaṃ heṭṭhā paggharitapupphapuñjā palālakhalasannibhāti vadati. ^14-16780

**Pokkharaṇī**ti caturassapokkharaṇī. **Nandane**ti nandanavane nandāpokkharaṇī viya. **Puppharasamattā**ti puppharasena mattā calitā. **Makarandehī**ti kiñjakkhehi. **Pokkhare** **pokkhare**ti paduminipaṇṇe paduminipaṇṇe. Tesu hi kiñjakkhato reṇu bhassitvā pokkharamadhu nāma hoti. **Dakkhiṇā atha pacchimā**ti ettāvatā sabbā disā vidisāpi vātā dassitā honti. **Thūlā** **siṅghāṭakā**ti mahantā siṅghāṭakā ca. **Saṃsādiyā**ti sayaṃ jātasālī, sukasālītipi vuccanti. **Pasādiyā**ti teyeva bhūmiyaṃ patitā. **Byāviddhā**ti pasanne udake byāviddhā paṭipāṭiyā gacchantā dissanti. **Mupayānakā**ti kakkaṭakā. **Madha**unti bhisakoṭiyā bhinnāya paggharaṇaraso madhusadiso hoti. **Khīrasappi muḷālibhī**ti muḷālehi paggharaṇaraso khīramissakanavanītasappi viya hoti. ^14-16781

**Sammaddatevā**ti sampattajanaṃ madayati viya. **Samantā mabhināditā**ti samantā abhinadantā vicaranti. **"Nandikā"**tiādīni tesaṃ nāmāni. Tesu hi paṭhamā "sāmi vessantara, imasmiṃ vane vasanto nandā"ti vadanti. Dutiyā "tvañca sukhena jīva, puttā ca te"ti vadanti. Tatiyā "tvañca jīva, piyā puttā ca te"ti vadanti. Catutthā "tvañca nanda, piyā puttā ca te"ti vadanti. Tena tesaṃ etāneva nāmāni ahesuṃ. **Pokkharaṇīgharā**ti pokkharaṇivāsino. ^14-16782

Evaṃ cetaputtena vessantarassa vasanaṭṭhāne akkhāte jūjako tussitvā paṭisanthāraṃ karonto imaṃ gāthamāha – ^14-16783

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2002]]

2002. "Idañca me sattubhattaṃ, madhunā paṭisaṃyutaṃ;
Madhupiṇḍikā ca sukatāyo, sattubhattaṃ dadāmi te"ti. ^14-16784

Tattha **sattubhatta**nti pakkamadhusannibhaṃ sattusaṅkhātaṃ bhattaṃ. Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – idaṃ mama atthi, taṃ te dammi, gaṇhāhi nanti. ^14-16785

Taṃ sutvā cetaputto āha – ^14-16786

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2003]]

2003. "Tuyheva sambalaṃ hotu, nāhaṃ icchāmi sambalaṃ;
Itopi brahme gaṇhāhi, gaccha brahme yathāsukhaṃ. ^14-16787

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2004]]

2004. "Ayaṃ ekapadī eti, ujuṃ gacchati assamaṃ;
Isīpi accuto tattha, paṅkadanto rajassiro;
Dhārento brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ, āsadañca masaṃ jaṭaṃ. ^14-16788

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2005]]

2005. "Cammavāsī chamā seti, jātavedaṃ namassati;
Taṃ tvaṃ gantvāna pucchassu, so te maggaṃ pavakkhatī"ti. ^14-16789

Tattha **sambala**nti pātheyyaṃ. **Etī**ti yo ekapadikamaggo amhākaṃ abhimukho eti, esa assamaṃ ujuṃ gacchati. **Accuto**ti evaṃnāmako isi tattha vasati. ^14-16790

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2006]]

2006. "Idaṃ sutvā brahmabandhu, cetaṃ katvā padakkhiṇaṃ;
Udaggacitto pakkāmi, yenāsi accuto isī"ti. ^14-16791

Tattha **yenāsī**ti yasmiṃ ṭhāne accuto isi ahosi, tattha gatoti. ^14-16792

Cūḷavanavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā. ^14-16793

##### Mahāvanavaṇṇanā ^14-22-10-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2007]]

2007. "Gacchanto so bhāradvājo, addassa accutaṃ isiṃ;

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2008]]

2008. "Kacci nu bhoto kusalaṃ, kacci bhoto anāmayaṃ;
Kacci uñchena yāpesi, kacci mūlaphalā bahū. ^14-16795

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2009]]

2009. "Kacci ḍaṃsā makasā ca, appameva sarīsapā;
Vane vāḷamigākiṇṇe, kacci hiṃsā na vijjatī"ti. ^14-16796

Tattha **bhāradvājo**ti jūjako. **Appamevā**ti appāyeva. **Hiṃsā**ti tesaṃ vasena tumhākaṃ vihiṃsā. ^14-16797

Tāpaso āha – ^14-16798

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2010]]

2010. "Kusalañceva me brahme, atho brahme anāmayaṃ;

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2011]]

2011. "Atho ḍaṃsā makasā ca, appameva sarīsapā;
Vane vāḷamigākiṇṇe, hiṃsā mayhaṃ na vijjati. ^14-16800

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2012]]

2012. "Bahūni vassapūgāni, assame vasato mama;
Nābhijānāmi uppannaṃ, ābādhaṃ amanoramaṃ. ^14-16801

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2013]]

2013. "Svāgataṃ te mahābrahme, atho te adurāgataṃ;
Anto pavisa bhaddante, pāde pakkhālayassu te. ^14-16802

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2014]]

2014. "Tindukāni piyālāni, madhuke kāsumāriyo;
Phalāni khuddakappāni, bhuñja brahme varaṃ varaṃ. ^14-16803

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2015]]

2015. "Idampi pānīyaṃ sītaṃ, ābhataṃ girigabbharā;
Tato piva mahābrahme, sace tvaṃ abhikaṅkhasī"ti. ^14-16804

Jūjako āha – ^14-16805

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2016]]

2016. "Paṭiggahitaṃ yaṃ dinnaṃ, sabbassa agghiyaṃ kataṃ;
Sañjayassa sakaṃ puttaṃ, sivīhi vippavāsitaṃ;
Tamahaṃ dassanamāgato, yadi jānāsi saṃsa me"ti. ^14-16806

Tattha **tamahaṃ dassanamāgato**ti taṃ ahaṃ dassanāya āgato. Tāpaso āha – ^14-16807

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2017]]

2017. "Na bhavaṃ eti puññatthaṃ, sivirājassa dassanaṃ;
Maññe bhavaṃ patthayati, rañño bhariyaṃ patibbataṃ;
Maññe kaṇhājinaṃ dāsiṃ, jāliṃ dāsañca icchasi. ^14-16808

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2018]]

2018. "Atha vā tayo mātāputte, araññā netumāgato;
Na tassa bhogā vijjanti, dhanaṃ dhaññañca brāhmaṇā"ti. ^14-16809

Tattha **na tassa bhogā**ti bho brāhmaṇa, tassa vessantarassa araññe viharantassa neva bhogā vijjanti, dhanadhaññañca na vijjati, duggato hutvā vasati, tassa santikaṃ gantvā kiṃ karissasīti? ^14-16810

Taṃ sutvā jūjako āha – ^14-16811

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2019]]

2019. "Akuddharūpohaṃ bhoto, nāhaṃ yācitumāgato;
Sādhu dassanamariyānaṃ, sannivāso sadā sukho. ^14-16812

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2020]]

2020. "Adiṭṭhapubbo sivirājā, sivīhi vippavāsito;
Tamahaṃ dassanamāgato, yadi jānāsi saṃsa me"ti. ^14-16813

Tassattho – ahaṃ, bho tāpasa, akuddharūpo, alaṃ ettāvatā, ahaṃ pana na kiñci vessantaraṃ yācitumāgato, ariyānaṃ pana dassanaṃ sādhu, sannivāso ca tehi saddhiṃ sukho. Ahaṃ tassa ācariyabrāhmaṇo, mayā ca so yato sivīhi vippavāsito, tato paṭṭhāya adiṭṭhapubbo, tenāhaṃ taṃ dassanatthāya āgato. Yadi tassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ jānāsi, saṃsa meti. ^14-16814

So tassa vacanaṃ sutvā saddahitvā "hotu sve saṃsissāmi te, ajja tāva idheva vasāhī"ti taṃ phalāphalehi santappetvā punadivase maggaṃ dassento dakkhiṇahatthaṃ pasāretvā āha – ^14-16815

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2021]]

2021. "Esa selo mahābrahme, pabbato gandhamādano;
Yattha vessantaro rājā, saha puttehi sammati. ^14-16816

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2022]]

2022. "Dhārento brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ, āsadañca masaṃ jaṭaṃ;
Cammavāsī chamā seti, jātavedaṃ namassati. ^14-16817

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2023]]

2023. "Ete nīlā padissanti, nānāphaladharā dumā;
Uggatā abbhakūṭāva, nīlā añjanapabbatā. ^14-16818

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2024]]

2024. "Dhavassakaṇṇā khadirā, sālā phandanamāluvā;
Sampavedhanti vātena, sakiṃ pītāva māṇavā. ^14-16819

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2025]]

2025. "Upari dumapariyāyesu, saṃgītiyova suyyare;
Najjuhā kokilasaṅghā, sampatanti dumā dumaṃ. ^14-16820

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2026]]

2026. "Avhayanteva gacchantaṃ, sākhāpattasamīritā;
Ramayanteva āgantaṃ, modayanti nivāsinaṃ;
Yattha vessantaro rājā, saha puttehi sammati. ^14-16821

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2027]]

2027. "Dhārento brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ, āsadañca masaṃ jaṭaṃ;
Cammavāsī chamā seti, jātavedaṃ namassati. ^14-16822

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2028]]

2028. "Karerimālā vitatā, bhūmibhāge manorame;
Saddalāharitā bhūmi, na tatthuddhaṃsate rajo. ^14-16823

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2029]]

2029. "Mayūragīvasaṅkāsā, tūlaphassasamūpamā;
Tiṇāni nātivattanti, samantā caturaṅgulā. ^14-16824

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2030]]

2030. "Ambā jambū kapitthā ca, nīce pakkā cudumbarā;
Paribhogehi rukkhehi, vanaṃ taṃ rativaḍḍhanaṃ. ^14-16825

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2031]]

2031. "Veḷuriyavaṇṇasannibhaṃ, macchagumbanisevitaṃ;
Suciṃ sugandhaṃ salilaṃ, āpo tatthapi sandati. ^14-16826

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2032]]

2032. "Tassāvidūre pokkharaṇī, bhūmibhāge manorame;
Padumuppalasañchannā, devānamiva nandane. ^14-16827

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2033]]

2033. "Tīṇi uppalajātāni, tasmiṃ sarasi brāhmaṇa;
Vicittaṃ nīlānekāni, setā lohitakāni cā"ti. ^14-16828

Tassattho heṭṭhā vuttasadisoyeva. **Karerimālā vitatā**ti kareripupphehi vitatā. **Saddalāharitā**ti dhuvasaddalena haritā. **Na tatthuddhaṃsate rajo**ti tasmiṃ vane appamattakopi rajo na uddhaṃsate. **Tūlaphassasamūpamā**ti mudusamphassatāya tūlaphassasadisā. **Tiṇāni nātivattantī**ti tāni tassā bhūmiyā mayūragīvavaṇṇāni tiṇāni samantato caturaṅgulappamāṇāneva vattanti, tato pana uttari na vaḍḍhanti. **Ambā jambū kapitthā cā**ti ambā ca jambū ca kapitthā ca. **Paribhogehī**ti nānāvidhehi pupphūpagaphalūpagehi paribhogarukkhehi. **Sandatī**ti tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe vaṅkapabbate kunnadīhi otarantaṃ udakaṃ sandati, pavattatīti attho. **Vicittaṃ nīlānekāni, setā lohitakāni cā**ti ekāni nīlāni, ekāni setāni, ekāni lohitakānīti imehi tīhi uppalajātehi taṃ saraṃ vicittaṃ. Susajjitapupphacaṅkoṭakaṃ viya sobhatīti dasseti. ^14-16829

Evaṃ caturassapokkharaṇiṃ vaṇṇetvā puna mucalindasaraṃ vaṇṇento āha – ^14-16830

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2034]]

2034. "Khomāva tattha padumā, setasogandhikehi ca;
Kalambakehi sañchanno, mucalindo nāma so saro. ^14-16831

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2035]]

2035. "Athettha padumā phullā, apariyantāva dissare;
Gimhā hemantikā phullā, jaṇṇutagghā upattharā. ^14-16832

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2036]]

2036. "Surabhī sampavāyanti, vicittapupphasanthatā;
Bhamarā pupphagandhena, samantā mabhināditā"ti. ^14-16833

Tattha **khomāvā**ti khomamayā viya paṇḍarā. **Setasogandhikehi cā**ti setuppalehi ca sogandhikehi ca kalambakehi ca so saro sañchanno. **Apariyantāva dissare**ti aparimāṇā viya dissanti. **Gimhā hemantikā**ti gimhe ca hemantike ca pupphitapadumā. **Jaṇṇutagghā upattharā**ti jaṇṇupamāṇe udake upattharā phullā honti, santhatā viya khāyanti. **Vicittapupphasanthatā**ti vicittā hutvā pupphehi santhatā sadā surabhī sampavāyanti. ^14-16834

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2037]]

2037. "Athettha udakantasmiṃ, rukkhā tiṭṭhanti brāhmaṇa;
Kadambā pāṭalī phullā, koviḷārā ca pupphitā. ^14-16835

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2038]]

2038. "Aṅkolā kacchikārā ca, pārijaññā ca pupphitā;
Vāraṇā vayanā rukkhā, mucalindamubhato saraṃ. ^14-16836

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2039]]

2039. "Sirīsā setapārisā, sādhu vāyanti paddhakā;
Nigguṇḍī sirīnigguṇḍī, asanā cettha pupphitā. ^14-16837

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2040]]

2040. "Paṅgurā bahulā selā, sobhañjanā ca pupphitā;
Ketakā kaṇikārā ca, kaṇaverā ca pupphitā. ^14-16838

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2041]]

2041. "Ajjunā ajjukaṇṇā ca, mahānāmā ca pupphitā;
Supupphitaggā tiṭṭhanti, pajjalanteva kiṃsukā. ^14-16839

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2042]]

2042. "Setapaṇṇī sattapaṇṇā, kadaliyo kusumbharā;
Dhanutakkārī pupphehi, sīsapāvaraṇāni ca. ^14-16840

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2043]]

2043. "Acchivā sallavā rukkhā, sallakiyo ca pupphitā;
Setageru ca tagarā, maṃsikuṭṭhā kulāvarā. ^14-16841

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2044]]

2044. "Daharā rukkhā ca vuddhā ca, akuṭilā cettha pupphitā;
Assamaṃ ubhato ṭhanti, agyāgāraṃ samantato"ti. ^14-16842

Tattha **tiṭṭhantī**ti saraṃ parikkhipitvā tiṭṭhanti. **Kadambā**ti kadambarukkhā. **Kacchikārā cā**ti evaṃnāmakā rukkhā. **Pārijaññā**ti rattamālā. **Vāraṇā vayanā**ti vāraṇarukkhā ca vayanarukkhā ca. **Mucalindamubhato sara**nti mucalindassa sarassa ubhayapassesu. **Setapārisā**ti setagaccharukkhā. Te kira setakkhandhā mahāpaṇṇā kaṇikārasadisapupphā honti. **Nigguṇḍī sirīnigguṇḍī**ti pakatinigguṇḍī ceva kāḷanigguṇḍī ca. **Paṅgurā**ti paṅgurarukkhā. **Kusumbharā**ti ekagacchā. **Dhanutakkārī pupphehī**ti dhanūnañca takkārīnañca pupphehi sobhitā. **Sīsapāvaraṇāni cā**ti sīsapehi ca varaṇehi ca sobhitā. **Acchivā**tiādayopi rukkhāyeva. **Setageru ca tagarā**ti setageru ca tagarā ca. **Maṃsikuṭṭhā kulāvarā**ti maṃsigacchā ca kuṭṭhagacchā ca kulāvarā ca. **Akuṭilā**ti ujukā. **Agyāgāraṃ samantato**ti agyāgāraṃ parikkhipitvā ṭhitāti attho. ^14-16843

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2045]]

2045. "Athettha udakantasmiṃ, bahujāto phaṇijjako;
Muggatiyo karatiyo, sevālasīsakā bahū. ^14-16844

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2046]]

2046. "Uddāpavattaṃ ulluḷitaṃ, makkhikā hiṅgujālikā;
Dāsimakañjako cettha, bahū nīcekalambakā. ^14-16845

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2047]]

2047. "Elamphurakasañchannā, rukkhā tiṭṭhanti brāhmaṇa;
Sattāhaṃ dhāriyamānānaṃ, gandho tesaṃ na chijjati. ^14-16846

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2048]]

2048. "Ubhato saraṃ mucalindaṃ, pupphā tiṭṭhanti sobhanā;
Indīvarehi sañchannaṃ, vanaṃ taṃ upasobhati. ^14-16847

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2049]]

2049. "Aḍḍhamāsaṃ dhāriyamānānaṃ, gandho tesaṃ na chijjati;
Nīlapupphī setavārī, pupphitā girikaṇṇikā;
Kalerukkhehi sañchannaṃ, vanaṃ taṃ tulasīhi ca. ^14-16848

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2050]]

2050. "Sammaddateva gandhena, pupphasākhāhi taṃ vanaṃ;
Bhamarā pupphagandhena, samantā mabhināditā. ^14-16849

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2051]]

2051. "Tīṇi kakkārujātāni, tasmiṃ sarasi brāhmaṇa;
Kumbhamattāni cekāni, murajamattāni tā ubho"ti. ^14-16850

Tattha **phaṇijjako**ti bhūtanako. **Muggatiyo**ti ekā muggajāti. **Karatiyo**ti rājamāso. **Sevālasīsakā**ti imepi gacchāyeva, api ca **sīsakā**ti rattacandanaṃ vuttaṃ. **Uddāpavattaṃ ulluḷita**nti taṃ udakaṃ tīramariyādabandhaṃ vātāpahataṃ ulluḷitaṃ hutvā tiṭṭhati. **Makkhikā hiṅgujālikā**ti hiṅgujālasaṅkhāte vikasitapupphagacche pañcavaṇṇā madhumakkhikā madhurassarena viravantiyo tattha vicarantīti attho. **Dāsimakañjako cetthā**ti imāni dve rukkhajātiyo ca ettha. **Nīcekalambakā**ti nīcakalambakā. **Elamphurakasañchannā**ti evaṃnāmikāya valliyā sañchannā. **Tesa**nti tesaṃ tassā valliyā pupphānaṃ sabbesampi vā etesaṃ dāsimakañjakādīnaṃ pupphānaṃ sattāhaṃ gandho na chijjati. Evaṃ gandhasampannāni pupphāni, rajatapaṭṭasadisavālukapuṇṇā bhūmibhāgā. **Gandho tesa**nti tesaṃ indīvarapupphādīnaṃ gandho aḍḍhamāsaṃ na chijjati. **Nīlapupphī**tiādikā pupphavalliyo. **Tulasīhi cā**ti tulasigacchehi ca. **Kakkārujātānī**ti valliphalāni. Tattha ekissā valliyā phalāni mahāghaṭamattāni, dvinnaṃ mudiṅgamattāni. Tena vuttaṃ "murajamattāni tā ubho"ti. ^14-16851

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2052]]

2052. "Athettha sāsapo bahuko, nādiyo haritāyuto;
Asī tālāva tiṭṭhanti, chejjā indīvarā bahū. ^14-16852

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2053]]

2053. "Apphoṭā sūriyavallī ca, kāḷīyā madhugandhiyā;
Asokā mudayantī ca, vallibho khuddapupphiyo. ^14-16853

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-khuddakanikaya.md#^14-22-2054]]

2054. "Koraṇḍakā anojā ca, pupphitā nāgamallikā;
